Standard: Windows shared mode (default).
Low latency: shared mode at the driver's smallest period (Windows 10+).
Exclusive: takes the device from other apps for the lowest latency.

column2:

独占：从其他应用手中接管设备，以获得最低延迟。
若某模式不可用，Infinite 会逐步退回到“标准”。点击“应用音频设置”后生效。

column2: 16 步音序器，带可拖动绘制的条形网格。可选择使用的步数，或让其匹配拍号，每 N 拍前进一步。可选滑音和双极性显示。

column1: A 16-step sequencer: drag the bar grid (paint across bars by dragging horizontally), choose how many steps to use or fit them to the transport's time signature, and it loops through them one step every N beats. Optional glide between steps and a bipolar display mode.
column2: 16 步音序器：拖动条形网格（水平拖动可连续绘制多个条），选择使用的步数或匹配传输的拍号，每 N 拍前进一步。可选步间滑音和双极性显示模式。

column1: A 2D pad exposing X and Y as two separate modulator outputs from one drag. The pad's path can be recorded, looped and replayed in time, like Resynthesize's orb.
column2: 一个 2D 控制板，一次拖动即可将 X 和 Y 作为两个独立的调制器输出。控制板的轨迹可以录制、循环并按时间回放，类似 Resynthesize 的球体。

column1: A 3D arrow mesh - shaft plus arrowhead. Named with a '3D' suffix because the 2D Shape node already has its own 'Arrow'.
column2: 3D 箭头网格——箭杆加箭头。名称带“3D”后缀，因为 2D Shape 节点已有自己的“Arrow”。

column1: A 3D cogwheel - 'depth' sets tooth depth, 'tooth depth'/'hub hole' shape the teeth and centre bore. Named with a '3D' suffix because the 2D Shape node already has its own 'Gear'.
column2: 3D 齿轮——“depth”设置齿深，“tooth depth”/“hub hole”决定齿形和中心孔。名称带“3D”后缀，因为 2D Shape 节点已有自己的“Gear”。

column1: A 3D extruded star - 'depth' sets extrusion depth, 'inner ratio' how deep the points cut in. Named with a '3D' suffix because the 2D Shape node already has its own 'Star'.
column2: 3D 挤出星形——“depth”设置挤出深度，“inner ratio”决定尖角凹陷的深度。名称带“3D”后缀，因为 2D Shape 节点已有自己的“Star”。

column1: A 3D viewpoint. Patch it into a Render 3D node's camera input to render from it instead of the default view.
column2: 3D 视点。将其连接到 Render 3D 节点的相机输入，即可从该视点渲染，而不是使用默认视图。

column1: A 4-faced platonic solid.
column2: 4 面正多面体。

column1: A Feedback node outputs what its input produced on the PREVIOUS frame. That one-frame delay is the whole point: it lets you wire a cycle without the graph chasing its own tail forever.
column2: Feedback 节点输出的是其输入在上一帧产生的内容。这一帧的延迟正是关键所在：它让你能接出一个循环，而不会让图无休止地追着自己的尾巴转。

column1: A GPU particle emitter - shape, rate, lifetime, launch speed/spread/direction, gravity/drag/turbulence, and start/end size and colour over each particle's life.
column2: GPU 粒子发射器——形状、速率、寿命、发射速度/散布/方向、重力/阻力/湍流，以及粒子生命周期内的起始/结束大小与颜色。

column1: A MIDI recorder and looper. Record captures whatever plays into it (tempo-relative, so it stays in sync if the BPM changes); Play loops that phrase back on top of the live input, which always passes through regardless of transport state. Loop toggles whether playback repeats or stops after one pass. Quantize snaps every recorded onset to the nearest grid line the moment recording stops. A topology rebuild elsewhere in the patch (any cable connect/disconnect) no longer clears a take - only Clear does. Like every other recorder in this app, the recording itself doesn't survive save/load - only loop/quantize do.
column2: MIDI 录音与循环器。Record 会捕获输入的所有内容（相对于速度，因此 BPM 改变时仍保持同步）；Play 将该乐句循环叠加在实时输入之上，实时输入无论传输状态如何都会直通。Loop 决定回放是重复还是播放一遍后停止。Quantize 会在录音结束的瞬间把每个录入的起音吸附到最近的网格线。补丁其他位置的拓扑重建（任何连线的连接/断开）不再清除录音，只有 Clear 才会。与本应用中的其他录音器一样，录音本身不会随保存/加载保留，只有 loop/quantize 会。

column1: A UV sphere - latitude/longitude subdivision.
column2: UV 球体——按纬度/经度细分。

column1: A cascade of allpass stages (order, 2-8) sweeping around cutoff at rate/depth - each pair of stages adds one more notch to the comb. Spread offsets the right channel's sweep phase for width.
column2: 一串全通级联（阶数 2-8），以速率/深度围绕截止频率扫动——每一对级为梳状响应再增加一个陷波。Spread 会偏移右声道的扫动相位以增加宽度。

column1: A centre-detent knob running -1 to +1, exposed as a modulator - the right control for anything that has a natural middle (pan, detune, tilt). Its 0..1 output puts the detent at exactly 0.5, which is also where a bipolar modulation binding reads as 'no modulation'.
column2: 中心有定位点的旋钮，范围 -1 到 +1，作为调制器输出——适用于任何有天然中点的参数（声像、失谐、倾斜）。它的 0..1 输出把定位点放在正好 0.5 处，双极性调制绑定在此处读作“无调制”。

column1: A circular wedge / pie-slice - Inner Ratio controls how much of the circle is cut away.
column2: 圆形扇面 / 饼图切片——Inner Ratio 控制圆被切掉的比例。

column1: A classic polyphonic virtual-analog synth voice with two analog-style oscillators (osc1 unison stack, osc2 tuning/detune/sync, sub osc one octave down, white noise, pre-filter drive stage, nonlinear ZDF Moog-ladder or SVF filter, and amplitude ADSR across up to 8 voices). Detune reads as the stack's true total width in cents, distributed unevenly across the stack the way separately mistuned circuits sit. Spread is stereo width: it splits the stack across two independent drive/filter chains and places each voice card in the image, so the sides carry different oscillators rather than one panned copy.
column2: 经典的复音虚拟模拟合成器声部，带两个模拟风格振荡器（osc1 为齐奏叠加，osc2 带调谐/失谐/同步，另有低一个八度的副振荡器、白噪声、滤波器前的失真驱动级、非线性 ZDF Moog 梯形或 SVF 滤波器，以及最多 8 个声部的振幅 ADSR）。Detune 读数为叠加的真实总宽度（单位音分），在叠加中不均匀分布，就像各自失调的电路那样。Spread 是立体声宽度：它把叠加拆分到两条独立的驱动/滤波链上，并把每个声部放置在声像中，使两侧承载不同的振荡器，而不是同一份声像偏移的副本。

column1: A cloth simulation over an input mesh - stiffness, iterations, damping, mass and shape retention, plus gravity, wind and optional ground collision. 'Reset' re-drops the cloth from its rest pose.
column2: 基于输入网格的布料模拟——刚度、迭代次数、阻尼、质量和形状保持，另有重力、风和可选的地面碰撞。“Reset”会让布料从静止姿态重新落下。

column1: A cogwheel silhouette - Sides sets tooth count.
column2: 齿轮轮廓——Sides 设置齿数。

column1: A compressor with peak or RMS detection, threshold, ratio, attack, release, makeup and an external sidechain input, over a live static transfer curve. Limiter is its own separate node.
column2: 压缩器，支持峰值或 RMS 检测、阈值、比率、启动、释放、补偿增益和外部侧链输入，并带有实时静态传输曲线。Limiter 是独立的节点。

column1: A compressor: threshold, ratio, attack, release, makeup, a peak/RMS detector switch, and a sidechain switch that feeds the detector from the second input pin instead of the main signal. The graph shows the static transfer curve - input dB in, output dB out.
column2: 压缩器：阈值、比率、启动、释放、补偿增益、峰值/RMS 检测切换，以及将检测器改由第二个输入引脚而非主信号供给的侧链开关。图表显示静态传输曲线——输入 dB 进，输出 dB 出。

column1: A cone - Sides sets how many-sided.
column2: 圆锥——Sides 设置边数。

column1: A crescent-moon shape - two overlapping circles subtracted from each other.
column2: 新月形——两个相互重叠的圆相减得到。

column1: A cube with rounded edges/corners - 'corner radius' sets how rounded.
column2: 圆角立方体——“corner radius”决定圆角程度。

column1: A cylinder - Sides sets how many-sided (low values give a prism).
column2: 圆柱——Sides 设置边数（取值较低时得到棱柱）。

column1: A cylinder with hemispherical caps - 'tube' sets the cap/body radius.
column2: 两端为半球帽的圆柱——“tube”设置端帽/主体半径。

column1: A donut / annulus - a circle with a hole; corner/thick controls the ring's thickness.
column2: 圆环 / 环形——带孔的圆；corner/thick 控制圆环的粗细。

column1: A filled/stroked circle - one of the Shape vector primitives, with size, feather, stroke and background controls.
column2: 填充/描边的圆——Shape 矢量图元之一，带大小、羽化、描边和背景控制。

column1: A filled/stroked ellipse - Aspect stretches it from a circle.
column2: 填充/描边的椭圆——Aspect 将圆拉伸成椭圆。

column1: A filled/stroked equilateral-style triangle.
column2: 填充/描边的近似等边三角形。

column1: A filled/stroked rectangle, with an optional corner radius.
column2: 填充/描边的矩形，可选圆角半径。

column1: A flat filled circle/disc mesh (as opposed to Cylinder, which has height).
column2: 平面填充的圆/圆盘网格（不同于有高度的 Cylinder）。

column1: A flat subdivided plane - one of the Geometry 3D primitives.
column2: 细分的平面——Geometry 3D 图元之一。

column1: A fractional delay line: time (tempo-synced by default, or free ms with 'sync to tempo' off), tone (bipolar tilt on the repeats), feedback (past 100% on purpose for self-oscillation - the output is soft-clipped, not the feedback itself), pan, duck (sidechains the wet signal off the dry input) and a bounce switch that cross-feeds left/right instead of repeating in place.
column2: 分数延迟线：time（默认同步到速度，关闭“sync to tempo”后为自由毫秒）、tone（对重复声施加双极性倾斜）、feedback（可有意超过 100% 以产生自振荡——被软削波的是输出，而不是反馈本身）、pan、duck（用干声输入对湿声做侧链）以及 bounce 开关（左右交叉反馈，而不是原地重复）。

column1: A free-floating note on the canvas - has no image input or output, just text. Double-click to edit.
column2: 画布上自由放置的便笺——没有图像输入或输出，只有文字。双击编辑。

column1: A gate on a note's pitch: scale snaps it to the nearest degree of the chosen scale/root, range drops anything outside lo..hi, and chance randomly drops the rest. A note that gets dropped has its note-off dropped with it, so nothing hangs.
column2: 针对音符音高的闸门：scale 把音高吸附到所选音阶/根音的最近音级，range 丢弃 lo..hi 之外的音，chance 随机丢弃其余音符。被丢弃的音符其 note-off 也会一并丢弃，因此不会出现悬挂音。

column1: A generative parametric curve/tube (line, circle, spiral, helix and other presets) extruded into a mesh, with point count, smoothness, spread, height, twist and tube radius/taper controls.
column2: 将生成式参数曲线/管道（直线、圆、螺旋、螺旋线及其他预设）挤出为网格，带点数、平滑度、散布、高度、扭转以及管半径/锥度控制。

column1: A generative source that free-runs on its own clock (synced to tempo or free-running seconds) rather than only reacting to a knob edit: each new note is the previous one plus a small random step (wander sets the max semitones), clamped to lo..hi and snapped to the chosen scale - a bounded random walk, not independent-per-step randomness, so the line wanders rather than jumps around.
column2: 一个生成式音源，按自己的时钟自由运行（同步到速度或自由秒数），而不是仅对旋钮编辑作出反应：每个新音符是上一个音符加一个随机小步（wander 设置最大半音数），限制在 lo..hi 范围内并吸附到所选音阶——这是有界随机游走，而非每步相互独立的随机，因此旋律线是漫游而不是乱跳。

column1: A granular synthesizer: it dissects a loaded sample (or audio recorded through its own 'record in' pin) into micro-grains and re-emits them - grain length and density set the texture, position/scan set where in the sample the grain cloud reads from, and freeze pins it there. The four random controls (position spray, length, pitch, pan) plus reverse probability are what turn a sample into a cloud rather than a stutter. Drag the waveform's edge handles to trim start/end; the grain dots on the display are the live emission.
column2: 颗粒合成器：它把已载入的采样（或通过自身“record in”引脚录入的音频）拆分成微小颗粒并重新发射——颗粒长度和密度决定质感，position/scan 决定颗粒云从采样的哪里读取，freeze 把它固定在那里。四个随机控件（位置散布、长度、音高、声像）加上反向概率，才让采样变成云而不是结巴。拖动波形边缘手柄可修剪起点/终点；显示屏上的颗粒点就是实时发射。

column1: A groove quantizer, not a grid one: wire a note chain in and it always listens to the actual spacing between your onsets while also correcting them in the same pass - no Learn/Stop, it just keeps adapting the more you play. The learned spacing profile is global: shared by every Predictive Quantize in every patch, and it keeps only your most recent onsets, so it tracks how you're playing now rather than an ever-growing history. Mix at 0 is untouched, mix at 1 snaps fully onto the nearest learned spacing. Unlike Quantizer's fixed grid, this follows however you actually played it, including swing or a template that isn't on a clean subdivision.
column2: 一个律动量化器，而非网格量化器：接入音符链后，它会一边持续聆听你起音之间的实际间隔，一边在同一次处理中校正它们——没有 Learn/Stop，你弹得越多它就越适应。学到的间隔档案是全局的：所有补丁中的每个 Predictive Quantize 共用它，并且只保留你最近的起音，因此它跟踪的是你现在的演奏方式，而不是不断增长的历史。Mix 为 0 时不做任何改动，为 1 时完全吸附到最近的已学间隔。与 Quantizer 的固定网格不同，它跟随你实际的演奏方式，包括摇摆或不落在整齐分割上的模板。

column1: A hand control whose only output is a modulator. Drag its output onto the small dot beside any slider to drive that parameter by hand, or onto several at once to make this one control the whole gesture.
column2: 只有一个调制器输出的手动控件。将其输出拖到任意滑块旁的小圆点上，即可手动驱动该参数；也可同时拖到多个参数上，让这一个控件完成整个手势。

column1: A hand-driven bend wheel, patched inline in the note chain like Note Transpose. Unlike a transpose (which can only re-pitch a note as it attacks), moving this knob slides every note currently held through it in real time - drag it while a chord rings and the chord bends, no need to route it onto a synth's own bend knob. Default range is +/-2 semitones, the standard wheel range.
column2: 手动弯音轮，像 Note Transpose 一样串联在音符链中。移调只能在起音时改变音符的音高，而这个旋钮会实时滑动所有经过它且正被按住的音符——和弦正在响时拖动它，和弦就会弯曲，无需把它路由到合成器自己的弯音旋钮。默认范围为 +/-2 个半音，即标准弯音轮范围。

column1: A hardware-free note source: click-and-drag the on-screen piano, or hover the node and type on your laptop keyboard (Logic/GarageBand's Musical Typing layout - ZXCVBNM... is one octave, QWERTY... the octave above) to test a patch with no MIDI controller at all.
column2: 无需硬件的音符源：点击并拖动屏幕钢琴，或将鼠标悬停在节点上，用笔记本键盘演奏（Logic/GarageBand 的 Musical Typing 布局——ZXCVBNM... 为一个八度，QWERTY... 为其上方的八度），无需任何 MIDI 控制器即可测试补丁。

column1: A heart-shaped outline.
column2: 心形轮廓。

column1: A helical tube spiraling around an axis - 'tube' sets the tube's radius.
column2: 绕轴盘旋的螺旋管——“tube”设置管的半径。

column1: A hollow cylinder - 'tube' sets the wall's inner radius.
column2: 空心圆柱——“tube”设置壁的内半径。

column1: A knotted torus - a tube swept along a (p,q) knot path rather than a plain circle.
column2: 打结的圆环——沿 (p,q) 结路径而不是普通圆扫出的管。

column1: A latching on/off switch exposed as a modulator: output is exactly 0.0 or 1.0, nothing in between. Useful for driving a mode/enable parameter, or for gating another modulator through a Math node's multiply.
column2: 以调制器形式输出的锁存开关：输出恰好是 0.0 或 1.0，没有中间值。适合驱动模式/启用参数，或通过 Math 节点的乘法对另一个调制器做门控。

column1: A learned dynamics curve, not a hand-picked one: wire a note chain in and it always listens to the velocities you play while also remapping them in the same pass - no Learn/Stop, it just keeps adapting the more you play. The learned curve is global: shared by every Predictive Velocity in every patch, and it keeps only your most recent notes, so it tracks how you're playing now rather than an ever-growing history. Mix at 0 is untouched, mix at 1 snaps fully onto the learned range, so your loudest playing maps to your own real loudest instead of a theoretical 127. Unlike Velocity Curve's one fixed shape, this follows your own dynamics.
column2: 一条学习得到的力度曲线，而不是手动选定的：接入音符链后，它会一边持续聆听你弹奏的力度，一边在同一次处理中重新映射——没有 Learn/Stop，你弹得越多它就越适应。学到的曲线是全局的：所有补丁中的每个 Predictive Velocity 共用它，并且只保留你最近的音符，因此它跟踪的是你现在的演奏方式，而不是不断增长的历史。Mix 为 0 时不做任何改动，为 1 时完全吸附到已学范围，使你最响的演奏映射到你自己真实的最大值，而不是理论上的 127。与 Velocity Curve 单一固定形状不同，它跟随你自己的力度变化。

column1: A light source for the 3D scene. Render 3D takes up to 3 lights - patch more in and only the first 3 are used.
column2: 3D 场景的光源。Render 3D 最多接受 3 盏灯——接入更多时只使用前 3 盏。

column1: A linear, radial, angular or diamond gradient with its own stops - the usual starting point for a mask or a Gradient Map source.
column2: 线性、径向、角度或菱形渐变，带有自己的色标——通常用作遮罩或 Gradient Map 来源的起点。

column1: A live GLSL shader. Pick a preset or press 'Edit GLSL...' to write your own; four knobs (uA-uD) are exposed for modulation.
column2: 实时 GLSL 着色器。选择预设，或点击“Edit GLSL...”编写你自己的；提供四个旋钮（uA-uD）供调制。

column1: A momentary pad: output is 1.0 while pressed and 0.0 the moment it is released, with a visible flash on the press. Reach for it to fire something that responds to an edge - a Feedback burst, an envelope, a Resynthesize step - rather than to hold a value.
column2: 瞬时触发板：按下时输出 1.0，松开瞬间输出 0.0，按下时有可见的闪光。适合触发响应边沿的东西——Feedback 的突发、包络、Resynthesize 的一步——而不是用来保持某个值。

column1: A multiple-choice selector emitting one discrete step per option - the control to use for a dropdown-shaped parameter (a mode, a waveform, a preset index), where a continuous slider would land between valid values. 'count' sets how many options.
column2: 多选一选择器，每个选项输出一个离散步进——适用于下拉菜单形式的参数（模式、波形、预设索引），连续滑块在这些参数上会落在有效值之间。“count”设置选项数量。

column1: A named fader exposed as a modulator - drag its output onto any slider's modulation pin to drive that parameter by hand. The plain 0..1 member of the Macro family; use Macro Knob when you want a response curve and invert as well.
column2: 以调制器形式输出的命名推子——将其输出拖到任意滑块的调制引脚上，即可手动驱动该参数。它是 Macro 系列中简单的 0..1 成员；需要响应曲线和反相时请用 Macro Knob。

column1: A new random value every N beats, with adjustable smoothing between steps. Deterministic, so rewinding replays the same sequence.
column2: 每 N 拍生成一个新的随机值，步间平滑可调。结果是确定性的，倒带时会重放相同的序列。

column1: A node's output can feed several inputs at once - it only renders once per frame.
column2: 一个节点的输出可以同时供给多个输入——每帧只渲染一次。

column1: A non-orientable closed surface - the classic self-intersecting 'bottle with no inside or outside'.
column2: 不可定向的封闭曲面——经典的自相交“没有内外之分的瓶子”。

column1: A number box with drag-to-scrub and direct typing, over a range and step you set yourself - for when the value matters as a number (a count, a Hz figure, a bar length) and a 0..1 slider would be the wrong instrument.
column2: 可拖动擦洗并可直接键入的数字框，范围和步长由你自己设定——适用于数值本身重要的场合（计数、Hz 数值、小节长度），此时 0..1 滑块并不合适。

column1: A one-sided, one-edge twisted strip - 'width' sets the strip's width.
column2: 单面单边的扭转带——“width”设置带宽。

column1: A pass-through node for geometry: its output is exactly its input mesh, unchanged. Useful as a stable junction point to branch geometry to several destinations.
column2: 几何体的直通节点：输出就是未经改动的输入网格。可作为稳定的连接点，把几何体分支到多个目的地。

column1: A pass-through node: its output is exactly its input, unchanged. Useful as a stable junction point to branch a cable to several destinations, or as a placeholder while rewiring.
column2: 直通节点：输出就是未经改动的输入。可作为稳定的连接点，把一根线缆分支到多个目的地，或在重新接线时充当占位。

column1: A physical-modelling synth for struck and plucked metal - bells, gongs, bars, plates, chimes, tines and strings - via extended Karplus-Strong waveguides and inharmonic modal resonator banks. 'material' picks the model, transient how hard it is struck, decay how long it rings, stiffness how inharmonic the partials are (which is what separates a bell from a string). Polyphonic with a note cable connected, free-running at 'frequency' when unpatched.
column2: 针对敲击和拨奏金属（钟、锣、条、板、风铃、簧片和琴弦）的物理建模合成器，基于扩展的 Karplus-Strong 波导和非谐波模态谐振器组。“material”选择模型，transient 决定敲击力度，decay 决定余音时长，stiffness 决定分音的非谐波程度（这正是钟与弦的区别）。连接音符线缆时为复音，未连接时按“frequency”自由运行。

column1: A plus-sign / cross shape.
column2: 加号 / 十字形。

column1: A polyphonic synth whose voice is a Field kernel you write yourself, compiled to a sample-domain register machine - the note-driven counterpart of Field Effect.
column2: 一个复音合成器，其声部是你自己编写的 Field 内核，编译为采样域寄存器机——是 Field Effect 的音符驱动版本。

column1: A polyphonic synthesizer whose voice is a Field kernel you write yourself, compiled to a sample-domain register machine - the note-driven counterpart of Field Effect. `state` declares per-voice memory, `param` exposes a modulatable knob, and the kernel runs once per sample per voice, on the audio thread. maxVoices caps the polyphony; presets are complete starting kernels.
column2: 一个复音合成器，其声部是你自己编写的 Field 内核，编译为采样域寄存器机——是 Field Effect 的音符驱动版本。`state` 声明每个声部的内存，`param` 暴露可调制的旋钮，内核在音频线程上对每个声部的每个采样运行一次。maxVoices 限制复音数；预设都是完整的起始内核。

column1: A pre-wired feedback loop: decaying accumulation with drift, zoom, rotation and hue rotation. Reach for this before wiring a Feedback loop by hand.
column2: 预接好的反馈环路：带漂移、缩放、旋转和色相旋转的衰减累积。手动连接 Feedback 环路之前，先用它。

column1: A pre-wired feedback loop: decaying accumulation with drift, zoom, rotation and hue rotation. Reach for this before wiring a loop by hand.
column2: 预接好的反馈环路：带漂移、缩放、旋转和色相旋转的衰减累积。手动连接环路之前，先用它。

column1: A prism - an extruded polygon with Sides sides.
column2: 棱柱——挤出的多边形，边数为 Sides。

column1: A pyramid - Sides sets the base's side count (4 = classic square pyramid).
column2: 棱锥——Sides 设置底面边数（4 = 经典四棱锥）。

column1: A rectangle with rounded corners - like Rectangle but with the corner radius exposed as its own control.
column2: 圆角矩形——类似 Rectangle，但圆角半径作为独立控件提供。

column1: A regular polygon - Sides sets how many.
column2: 正多边形——Sides 设置边数。

column1: A ring/donut solid - 'tube' sets the tube radius relative to the overall ring.
column2: 环形 / 甜甜圈实体——“tube”设置管半径相对于整个环的比例。

column1: A sample player: load a file (or drag one in from the Samples search panel), or record from the audio input pin. Click the waveform to audition from that point, or use the audition button - both preview this node on its own dedicated voice, independent of the transport and any note cable, and never cut off or get cut off by an incoming note. Drag the waveform's two edge handles to set the loop range (start/end). pitch/finetune are coarse/fine tuning, speed is a -2..2 varispeed control (negative plays backward), volume is the output level. loop/rev/p-p control what happens at the range edges: loop wraps or bounces (ping-pong) instead of stopping, reverse flips the base direction. fade in / fade out are lengths in ms applied at the start and end of every pass through the range (each loop lap, ping-pong leg or one-shot), so a loop dips at its seam instead of clicking; 3 ms each by default, 0 for a hard edge. Patches saved with the old loop xfade load with the defaults. With no note cable connected, it free-runs on the transport - starts the moment you hit space, stops when you stop it; connect a note cable and it becomes polyphonic instead, each note played back at the pitch offset from middle C. Spacebar always silences every voice this node is making.
column2: 采样播放器：载入文件（或从 Samples 搜索面板拖入一个），或从音频输入引脚录音。点击波形可从该点试听，也可使用试听按钮——两者都在专用声部上预听此节点，独立于传输和任何音符线缆，既不会切断传入音符，也不会被其切断。拖动波形的两个边缘手柄可设置循环范围（起点/终点）。pitch/finetune 为粗调/微调，speed 为 -2..2 的变速控制（负值反向播放），volume 为输出电平。loop/rev/p-p 控制范围边缘的行为：loop 会回绕或来回弹跳（乒乓）而不是停止，reverse 翻转基础方向。fade in / fade out 是应用于每次穿过该范围的起点和终点的时长（毫秒，对应每圈循环、乒乓的每一段或单次播放），因此循环在接缝处会下沉而不是发出咔嗒声；默认各 3 毫秒，0 表示硬边。用旧版循环交叉淡化保存的补丁以默认值载入。未连接音符线缆时，它随传输自由运行——按下空格即开始，停止时即停；连接音符线缆后则变为复音，每个音符相对于中央 C 的音高偏移进行回放。空格键始终会静音此节点的所有声部。

column1: A self-playing generative chord engine. Every groove step it picks a random scale degree and stacks chord-sized thirds on top of it, in key. Strum spaces each chord tone's onset apart instead of firing them all at once; humanise timing and velocity add per-note randomness on top; harmonics is the chance any given chord gets an extra note an octave above one of its tones.
column2: 自动演奏的生成式和弦引擎。每个律动步它会随机选取一个音阶级数，并在其上按调内叠置和弦大小的三度。Strum 把每个和弦音的起音错开，而不是同时触发；humanise 为每个音符的时值和力度叠加随机性；harmonics 是任一和弦获得比其某个音高一个八度的额外音符的概率。

column1: A self-playing step sequencer, up to 16 steps. Drag a bar's tall upper area to set that step's pitch, drag the thin strip below it to set velocity, click the strip to toggle the step on/off. Steps sets how many loop, rate is either synced to tempo (a note division) or free-running in seconds, gate is how much of each step the note actually sounds for.
column2: 自动演奏的步进音序器，最多 16 步。拖动条的高处区域可设置该步的音高，拖动其下方的细条可设置力度，点击细条可开关该步。Steps 设置循环的步数，rate 要么同步到速度（音符分割），要么以秒自由运行，gate 决定每一步中音符实际发声的比例。

column1: A simulated ocean surface mesh - Gerstner-style waves with amplitude, wavelength, steepness, choppiness, direction and octaves for layered swell.
column2: 模拟的海洋表面网格——Gerstner 风格的波浪，带振幅、波长、陡度、浪涌、方向和倍频程，用于叠加涌浪。

column1: A single gain stage in dB, with a level meter - the simplest audio utility there is. Reach for it to trim a source before a Mixer, or to set up a clean level for something that has no output volume of its own.
column2: 以 dB 计的单级增益，带电平表——最简单的音频工具。可用来在 Mixer 之前修整音源，或为没有自带输出音量的东西设定干净的电平。

column1: A single named slider (0-1, with a response curve and invert) meant to be patched out to several other sliders at once - one control that fans out to many parameters.
column2: 单个命名滑块（0-1，带响应曲线和反相），用于同时接到多个其他滑块——一个控件扇出到许多参数。

column1: A six-sided regular polygon (a Polygon preset with Sides fixed to 6).
column2: 正六边形（Sides 固定为 6 的 Polygon 预设）。

column1: A sound source - it produces audio rather than an image. With a note cable connected it plays polyphonically; with nothing patched into its note pin it free-runs at its own frequency. Route its output into an audio effect chain and on to Audio Out.
column2: 声音源——产生音频而不是图像。连接音符线缆时以复音演奏；音符引脚上没有连接时，按自己的频率自由运行。把它的输出送入音频效果链，再接到 Audio Out。

column1: A source node - generates or loads an image with no image input of its own.
column2: 源节点：生成或载入图像，自身没有图像输入。

column1: A sphere built from subdivided triangles (an icosahedron refined outward) - more even triangle distribution than a UV Sphere.
column2: 由细分三角形构成的球体（向外细化的二十面体）——三角形分布比 UV Sphere 更均匀。

column1: A star with adjustable point count (Sides) and Inner Ratio for how deep the points cut in.
column2: 角数可调（Sides）的星形，Inner Ratio 决定尖角凹陷的深度。

column1: A stereo level meter: separate L and R bars on a shared -60 to +3 dBFS scale, each showing RMS (solid) inside peak (faint), a peak-hold line, and the channel's highest peak as a number on top, which turns red once that channel has reached 0 dBFS. Audio passes through unchanged. It measures whatever its input is patched to even with its output left unconnected, so it can hang off any cable as a tap. Click the meter to clear the peak numbers, holds and clip.
column2: 立体声电平表：L 和 R 两个独立的条，共用 -60 到 +3 dBFS 的刻度，各自在峰值（淡色）内显示 RMS（实色）、一条峰值保持线，以及顶部以数字显示的该声道最高峰值，该声道一旦达到 0 dBFS 数字就会变红。音频原样通过。即使输出未连接，它也会测量输入所连接的信号，因此可作为分接点挂在任意线缆上。点击电平表可清除峰值数字、保持线和削波标记。

column1: A straight stroked line, without a fill interior.
column2: 一条描边直线，没有填充内部。

column1: A subdivided cube/box.
column2: 细分的立方体/盒子。

column1: A superformula-based shape - 'depth', 'tooth depth' and 'hub hole' warp it into gear-like or organic silhouettes.
column2: 基于超公式的形状——“depth”、“tooth depth”和“hub hole”可将其扭曲成齿轮状或有机的轮廓。

column1: A synth defined by a live formula (y = f(x, a, b, c, d, t)) instead of a fixed waveform - knobs a-d feed the equation directly, so turning them reshapes the waveform itself rather than modulating a preset one.
column2: 由实时公式（y = f(x, a, b, c, d, t)）而非固定波形定义的合成器——旋钮 a-d 直接馈入方程，因此转动它们会重塑波形本身，而不是调制某个预设波形。

column1: A synth oscillator with four classic waveforms (sine, triangle, saw, square), interactive amp envelope, unison, filter, hard sync, and fine/coarse tuning. With no note cable connected, it free-runs at a set frequency; connect a note cable and it becomes polyphonic and envelope-gated.
column2: 带四种经典波形（正弦、三角、锯齿、方波）、交互式振幅包络、齐奏、滤波器、硬同步和微调/粗调的合成器振荡器。未连接音符线缆时以固定频率自由运行；连接音符线缆后变为复音并由包络门控。

column1: A tanh saturator: drive (0-40dB into the shaper), bias (asymmetry - the difference between fuzzy and warm), tone (bipolar tilt after the shaper) and output trim. A DC blocker always runs since bias otherwise leaks a constant offset.
column2: tanh 饱和器：drive（0-40 dB 送入整形器）、bias（不对称——毛刺感与温暖感的区别）、tone（整形器之后的双极性倾斜）和输出微调。始终运行直流阻断器，因为否则 bias 会漏出恒定的偏移。

column1: A teardrop / droplet outline.
column2: 泪滴 / 水滴形轮廓。

column1: A true single-sideband frequency shifter: moves every partial by the same number of Hz rather than multiplying frequencies (Pitch Shifter) or producing sum/difference pairs (Ring Mod) - destroying harmonic relationships for classic metallic and inharmonic textures, or rising/falling barber-pole spirals with feedback.
column2: 真正的单边带频移器：把每个分音移动相同的 Hz 数，而不是倍乘频率（Pitch Shifter）或产生和/差频对（Ring Mod）——破坏谐波关系，得到经典的金属感和非谐波质感，或在加入反馈后得到上升/下降的理发店旋转灯式螺旋。

column1: A two-input crossfader: blend 0 is A only, 1 is B only, 0.5 an equal-power centre. Not a second place to sum two signals (that's Mixer) - it picks a point between them, and its blend knob has a modulation pin, so an LFO or Macro can sweep the crossfade.
column2: 双输入交叉渐变器：blend 为 0 时只有 A，为 1 时只有 B，0.5 为等功率中点。它不是求和两个信号的另一处（那是 Mixer）——它在两者之间选取一个点，且其 blend 旋钮带调制引脚，因此 LFO 或 Macro 可以扫动交叉渐变。

column1: A two-tap delay-line pitch shifter: pitch in semitones, grain size in ms (shorter grains track fast material better but sound more granular). No formant correction - octave shifts will chipmunk/deepen the timbre along with the pitch.
column2: 双抽头延迟线变调器：音高以半音为单位，颗粒大小以毫秒为单位（颗粒越短越能跟上快速素材，但听起来越有颗粒感）。没有共振峰校正——八度移调会让音色随音高一起变尖/变沉。

column1: A unipolar gain envelope traced by a sub-audio LFO (rate/sync, shape, stereo phase, depth) - amplitude modulation, not ring modulation (see Ring Mod above): the original frequencies pass through unchanged, only the level rises and falls.
column2: 由次声频 LFO 描绘的单极性增益包络（速率/同步、波形、立体声相位、深度）——这是振幅调制而非环形调制（见上方的 Ring Mod）：原始频率原样通过，只有电平起伏。

column1: A user-editable 3x3 convolution kernel (k11-k33) - blur, sharpen, edge-detect and emboss are all just different numbers in this grid. Divisor and Bias adjust the result, Spread scales the sample distance, Mix blends with the original.
column2: 可由用户编辑的 3x3 卷积核（k11-k33）——模糊、锐化、边缘检测和浮雕只是这个网格中不同的数字。Divisor 和 Bias 调整结果，Spread 缩放采样距离，Mix 与原图混合。

column1: Action
column2: 操作

column1: Add Marker
column2: 添加标记

column1: Add Node
column2: 添加节点

column1: Add Note / Comment
column2: 添加便笺 / 注释

column1: Add a Palette node, give it a reference image, then drag its 'out' onto the square dot beside any colour swatch. Each new cable takes the next swatch; click a bound swatch to step it.
column2: 添加一个 Palette 节点，给它一张参考图像，然后将它的“out”拖到任意色板旁的方形圆点上。每根新线缆会占用下一个色板；点击已绑定的色板可逐个切换。

column1: Add a new audio track below the selected track (Shift+K toggles the audio engine when the canvas has focus)
column2: 在所选轨道下方添加新的音频轨道（画布获得焦点时，Shift+K 切换音频引擎）

column1: Add a new video track below the selected track. Every key in this section needs the timeline panel focused - click inside it first
column2: 在所选轨道下方添加新的视频轨道。本节中的所有按键都要求时间线面板获得焦点——请先在其中点击

column1: Add a node
column2: 添加节点

column1: Adds a soft glow of a chosen Colour around the image's alpha edge, blurred outward. Amount controls strength.
column2: 沿图像的 Alpha 边缘添加所选 Colour 的柔和辉光，向外模糊。Amount 控制强度。

column1: Adds random per-pixel grain, re-randomised every frame. Amount sets how strong it is.
column2: 添加逐像素的随机颗粒，每帧重新随机。Amount 设置强度。

column1: Adds small random offsets to incoming note timing and velocity, so a mechanically even sequence sounds played by hand instead of quantized.
column2: 为传入音符的时值和力度添加微小的随机偏移，使机械均匀的序列听起来像手弹的而不是量化的。

column1: All-in-one grading chain - brightness/contrast, levels, colour balance, HSL, vibrance, tone shaper, channel mixer and an optional black & white stage - so a common grade doesn't need eight nodes wired in series.
column2: 一体化调色链——亮度/对比度、色阶、色彩平衡、HSL、自然饱和度、色调整形器、通道混合器和可选的黑白级——这样常见的调色就不必串联八个节点。

column1: All-in-one grading chain: Brightness/Contrast, Levels, Colour Balance, HSL, Vibrance, Tone Shaper (lift/gamma/gain-style S-curve), Channel Mixer, then an optional Black & White stage - so a common grade doesn't need eight separate nodes wired in series.
column2: 一体化调色链：Brightness/Contrast、Levels、Colour Balance、HSL、Vibrance、Tone Shaper（lift/gamma/gain 风格的 S 曲线）、Channel Mixer，然后是可选的 Black & White 级——这样常见的调色就不必串联八个独立节点。

column1: An 8-faced platonic solid.
column2: 8 面正多面体。

column1: An 8-lane, up-to-32-step drum machine: 8 lane cards (waveform + transient/decay/pitch/fine tune/volume/pan) above an 8-lane step grid that shows 16 steps at a time (the small 1-16 | 17-32 pill at the right of the line under it switches pages once steps goes past 16 - greyed out until then; a dot marks the page the playhead is on). Click a card's waveform to load its sample (a drag from the Samples panel or an OS file drop also work), or drag its edge handles to trim the playback range; x clears it, and the choke button cycles its choke group (0 = none - two lanes sharing a group cut each other off, the closed/open hi-hat case). In the grid, R randomises that lane's fill, M/S mute or solo it. Click a step to toggle it, drag vertically on a lit step to set its velocity, drag horizontally to paint a run of steps on/off. Between the lane cards and the grid, the groove picker holds a built-in library of 141 grooves in 10 categories: pick a category (jumps to its first groove) or a groove (the list is grouped and has a filter box), step through with < and >, and switch the groove's A verse / B bridge / C chorus part with the small A B C pill at the end of the row; picking replaces the pattern, rate, swing and step count in one undo step and fills any empty lane from the bundled kit (a lane you loaded yourself is never touched). The bottom rows are pattern-wide: rate/steps/swing/output, then four offsets (transient/decay/pitch/pan) composed on top of every lane's own value. Plays the moment it's patched, phase-locked to the transport - there's no note input, just its own Transport-derived sequence. run stops this node's own step firing without touching the transport; randomise seeds a musical kick/snare/hat starting pattern.
column2: 8 通道、最多 32 步的鼓机：8 个通道卡片（波形 + transient/decay/pitch/fine tune/volume/pan）位于 8 通道步进网格上方，网格一次显示 16 步（下方行右侧的小型 1-16 | 17-32 标签在 steps 超过 16 后用于切换页面，在此之前为灰色；圆点标记播放头所在的页面）。点击卡片的波形可载入其采样（从 Samples 面板拖入或从操作系统拖入文件也可以），或拖动其边缘手柄修剪回放范围；x 清除，choke 按钮循环切换其闷音组（0 = 无——同组的两个通道会互相切断，即闭合/开放踩镲的情形）。在网格中，R 随机化该通道的填充，M/S 将其静音或独奏。点击某一步可切换，在点亮的步上垂直拖动可设置其力度，水平拖动可连续绘制一串步的开/关。在通道卡片与网格之间，律动选择器内置一个包含 141 种律动、分 10 个类别的库：选择类别（跳到其第一个律动）或选择某个律动（列表已分组并带有过滤框），用 < 和 > 逐个切换，并用行末的小型 A B C 标签切换该律动的 A 主歌 / B 桥段 / C 副歌部分；选择后会在一次撤销步骤中替换图案、速率、摇摆和步数，并用内置鼓组填充任何空通道（你自己载入的通道不会被改动）。底部几行作用于整个图案：rate/steps/swing/output，然后是四个偏移（transient/decay/pitch/pan），叠加在每个通道自身的值之上。接上即开始演奏，与传输锁相——没有音符输入，只有它自己由传输派生的序列。run 停止此节点自身的步进触发而不影响传输；randomise 生成有音乐性的底鼓/军鼓/踩镲起始图案。

column1: An 8-line feedback delay network: size (room size), decay (RT60 in seconds), damping (darkens and speeds up the tail), predelay (gap before the reverb starts), width (stereo spread, full at 1 down to mono at 0) and mix. Algorithmic only - no convolution engine.
column2: 8 线反馈延迟网络：size（房间大小）、decay（以秒计的 RT60）、damping（使尾音变暗并加快衰减）、predelay（混响开始前的间隔）、width（立体声展宽，1 为完整，0 为单声道）和 mix。仅为算法式——没有卷积引擎。

column1: An 8-step gate that advances on the transport at rateBeats - a rhythm you draw rather than a curve. The output is the current step's on/off state, so it is the Macro family's answer to 'make this parameter pulse in time' without wiring an LFO and a Compare.
column2: 8 步闸门，随传输按 rateBeats 前进——是你绘制的节奏而不是曲线。输出为当前步的开/关状态，因此这是 Macro 系列对“让这个参数随拍子脉动”的回答，无需连接 LFO 和 Compare。

column1: An LFO wired straight to pitch. It is a modulator, not a note-chain node - it has no note input on purpose, because a free-running wobble has no single note to attach to. Patch its output onto a synth's pitch/bend mod dot (e.g. Wavetable's 'bend' knob).
column2: 直接接到音高的 LFO。它是调制器，而不是音符链中的节点——故意不设音符输入，因为自由运行的摆动没有可附着的单个音符。将其输出接到合成器的 pitch/bend 调制点上（例如 Wavetable 的“bend”旋钮）。

column1: An angled bracket / chevron shape.
column2: 尖括号 / 人字形。

column1: An arrow shape - direction follows the Rotation control.
column2: 箭头形状——方向跟随 Rotation 控件。

column1: An audio effect whose DSP is a Field kernel you write in the node, compiled to a sample-domain register machine rather than interpreted. Field Synth is its note-driven sibling and Field Graph plots what a kernel does.
column2: 音频效果，其 DSP 是你在节点内编写的 Field 内核，编译为采样域寄存器机而非解释执行。Field Synth 是它的音符驱动版本，Field Graph 则绘制内核的行为。

column1: An exponential moving average over another modulator, to damp jitter.
column2: 对另一个调制器做指数移动平均，以抑制抖动。

column1: An exponential moving average over another modulator, to damp jittery or steppy sources like Random or Pattern.
column2: 对另一个调制器做指数移动平均，以抑制 Random 或 Pattern 这类抖动或阶梯状的来源。

column1: An image generated by a Field kernel you write yourself: the per-pixel counterpart of Field Effect, compiled rather than interpreted.
column2: 由你自己编写的 Field 内核生成的图像：Field Effect 的逐像素版本，编译执行而非解释执行。

column1: An interactive on-screen piano plus laptop-keyboard typing (Musical Typing layout) - the hardware-free way to play or test a patch.
column2: 交互式屏幕钢琴加笔记本键盘输入（Musical Typing 布局）——无需硬件即可演奏或测试补丁。

column1: An organic, wobbly rounded shape - randomised per Seed-like controls rather than a precise geometric primitive.
column2: 有机、摇晃的圆润形状——由类似 Seed 的控件随机生成，而不是精确的几何图元。

column1: Analysis/genome resynthesis: decomposes a loaded or recorded sample into tracked harmonic partials plus a real residual waveform, then Roll mutates a parameter genome and re-renders a new sample from it - each roll walks further from the last, not from the original. Iterate feeds the last render back in as the new source and re-analyses it (progressively eating the sound); Reset returns fully to the originally loaded/recorded sample - generation 0 and the six shaping knobs (tone/air/snap/stretch/time/pitch) back to neutral, and the analysis itself restored, undoing any Iterate. chaos sets how far the next roll jumps; pitch offsets on top of the genome's own pitch walk; tone balances partials against residual; air/snap are the residual's steady-hiss and transient-attack levels; stretch scales inharmonicity together with harmonic spacing; time warps the attack/decay timing without changing the sample's length. This is a sound designer, not a playable instrument - it takes no note input, only a single self-triggered voice with start/end range, loop, reverse and ping-pong, the same transport as Sampler. Analysis and rendering both run on a background thread, so rolling never stalls the UI. seed/gen/f0/harm in the readout are the exact genome (seed + generation count) and the analysed pitch - two integers are enough to reproduce any rolled sound exactly on reload.
column2: 分析/基因组再合成：把已载入或录制的采样分解为被追踪的谐波分音加一条真实的残余波形，然后 Roll 对参数基因组进行变异并据此重新渲染出新采样——每次 roll 都离上一次更远，而不是离原始采样更远。Iterate 把上一次渲染结果作为新来源反馈回去并重新分析（逐步吞噬声音）；Reset 完全回到最初载入/录制的采样——第 0 代，六个塑形旋钮（tone/air/snap/stretch/time/pitch）回到中性，分析本身也被恢复，撤销任何 Iterate。chaos 设置下一次 roll 跳多远；pitch 在基因组自身的音高游走之上叠加偏移；tone 平衡分音与残余；air/snap 是残余的稳态嘶声和瞬态起音的电平；stretch 把非谐波性与谐波间距一同缩放；time 扭曲起音/衰减时序而不改变采样长度。这是声音设计器而非可演奏的乐器——它没有音符输入，只有单个自触发声部，带起点/终点范围、循环、反向和乒乓，与 Sampler 使用相同的传输。分析和渲染都在后台线程上运行，因此 roll 永远不会卡住界面。读数中的 seed/gen/f0/harm 是精确的基因组（种子 + 代数）和分析出的音高——两个整数就足以在重新载入时精确重现任何 roll 出的声音。

column1: Applies a lookup-table image patched into the second input.
column2: 应用接入第二个输入的查找表图像。

column1: Applies an ADSR contour to an incoming modulator instead of generating its own trigger: rising above threshold starts attack/decay/sustain, falling back below it starts release. Patch an LFO in and its swing gets shaped by the ADSR, retriggering once per LFO cycle. Output collapses toward 0.5 as the envelope level falls - at level 0 the input has no say, at level 1 it passes through unchanged - so with nothing patched in, 'in' holds steady at its own constant value.
column2: 对传入的调制器应用 ADSR 轮廓，而不是自己生成触发：升到阈值以上时开始 attack/decay/sustain，回落到阈值以下时开始 release。接入 LFO 时，它的摆动会被 ADSR 塑形，并在每个 LFO 周期重新触发一次。随着包络电平下降，输出向 0.5 收拢——电平为 0 时输入毫无作用，电平为 1 时原样通过——因此未连接任何东西时，“in”保持其自身常量值不变。

column1: Applies shading, colour, metallic/roughness/opacity and emission to a geometry input, plus an optional normal map input (its strength slider only appears once something is patched into it).
column2: 为几何体输入应用着色、颜色、金属度/粗糙度/不透明度和自发光，另有可选的法线贴图输入（其强度滑块只有在接入内容后才出现）。

column1: Audio engine on / off
column2: 音频引擎 开 / 关

column1: Balls bounce around inside a shape and emit a random note in lo..hi range every time one hits the wall, flashing orange briefly on the hit. Shape swaps the boundary between circle, square and triangle; size and speed are the balls' own; balls sets how many are simulated at once.
column2: 小球在一个形状内弹跳，每次撞墙都会在 lo..hi 范围内发出一个随机音符，并在撞击时短暂闪烁橙色。Shape 在圆形、方形和三角形边界之间切换；size 和 speed 是小球自身的参数；balls 设置同时模拟的数量。

column1: Beat-synced buffer repeater, freeze, reverse playback, and granular slice retriggering.
column2: 与速度同步的缓冲区重复器、冻结、反向播放以及颗粒切片重触发。

column1: Bends or conforms the source input onto the target input. Cylindrical rolls it around one axis at the target's radius with no distortion at all - letterforms, spacing and extrusion depth survive intact, which is what curves 3D text around a sphere or cylinder. Spherical adds the same bend the other way so long text also curves over the poles. Nearest Surface snaps every vertex to the closest point on the target instead: right for conforming a dense mesh to irregular geometry, but it squashes flat text. With a target connected the bend radius follows the target's size, so scaling the target moves the source with it - radius scale tunes it as a multiplier. With no target, radius sets the bend outright.
column2: 把源输入弯曲或贴合到目标输入上。Cylindrical 以目标的半径把它绕某根轴卷起，完全没有变形——字形、间距和挤出深度都保持完好，这正是让 3D 文字环绕球体或圆柱的方式。Spherical 在另一个方向上添加同样的弯曲，使长文本也能绕过两极。Nearest Surface 则把每个顶点吸附到目标上最近的点：适合让密集网格贴合不规则几何体，但会压扁平面文字。连接目标后，弯曲半径跟随目标的大小，因此缩放目标会带着源一起移动——radius scale 作为倍数对其微调。没有目标时，radius 直接设置弯曲半径。

column1: Binds one physical control on a MIDI controller - a knob, fader or pad - and reports its position as a modulator. Press Learn and move the control; the node remembers that channel + controller number and polls only that binding. low/high remap the output range and invert flips it. Works with any class-compliant USB MIDI controller, since it only ever reads generic Control Change / Note On messages. You rarely need to add this node by hand: right-click any parameter, choose MIDI learn, and move a control - this node is created (or reused if that control already has one) and bound to the parameter over its full range. Only one MIDI learn runs at a time; starting another cancels the first, and Esc cancels.
column2: 绑定 MIDI 控制器上的一个物理控件（旋钮、推子或打击垫），并将其位置作为调制器输出。按下 Learn 并移动该控件；节点会记住该通道 + 控制器编号，只轮询这一绑定。low/high 重映射输出范围，invert 将其反相。适用于任何符合类规范的 USB MIDI 控制器，因为它只读取通用的 Control Change / Note On 消息。你很少需要手动添加此节点：右键点击任意参数，选择 MIDI learn，然后移动一个控件——此节点会被创建（如果该控件已有一个则复用），并在整个范围内绑定到该参数。同一时间只能运行一个 MIDI learn；开始另一个会取消第一个，按 Esc 取消。

column1: Blade Tool
column2: 刀片工具

column1: Blend  ->  transform  (scale 1.02, small rotation)
column2: Blend  ->  变换  （缩放 1.02，小幅旋转）

column1: Blender-standard procedural textures: Voronoi, Brick, Magic, Wave and Musgrave, each with its own parameter block.
column2: Blender 标准程序纹理：Voronoi、Brick、Magic、Wave 和 Musgrave，各自带有独立的参数块。

column1: Block pixelation, additive grain and a vignette with its own centre.
column2: 块状像素化、叠加颗粒和带独立中心的暗角。

column1: Bloom isolates pixels above a threshold and blooms them outward. Diffuse Glow screens a blurred copy back over the image.
column2: Bloom 提取高于阈值的像素并向外扩散。Diffuse Glow 把模糊的副本以滤色方式叠回图像上。

column1: Blurs by averaging a flat square of neighbouring pixels - cheaper and blockier than Gaussian Blur. Radius sets the box size.
column2: 通过对相邻像素的平面方块求平均来模糊——比 Gaussian Blur 更省性能，也更有块状感。Radius 设置方框大小。

column1: Blurs outward from a centre point, like a zoom or spin blur. Amount sets the strength, Center X/Y the origin.
column2: 从中心点向外模糊，类似缩放或旋转模糊。Amount 设置强度，Center X/Y 设置原点。

column1: Blurs the image with a Gaussian-weighted kernel - a smooth, natural blur. Radius sets how far it samples.
column2: 用高斯加权核模糊图像——平滑自然的模糊。Radius 设置采样范围。

column1: Boolean difference: subtracts every input after the first from the first, like a cookie cutter. Needs closed, manifold input.
column2: 布尔差集：从第一个输入中减去其后的每个输入，就像饼干模具。需要封闭的流形输入。

column1: Boolean intersection: keeps only the volume where all the closed, manifold input solids overlap.
column2: 布尔交集：只保留所有封闭流形输入实体重叠的体积。

column1: Boolean union: fuses two or more closed, manifold solids into one, keeping their combined outer surface.
column2: 布尔并集：把两个或更多封闭流形实体融合为一个，保留它们合并后的外表面。

column1: Boosts or cuts a signal's transient hits (attack) separately from its sustained body (sustain), via a fast/slow envelope-difference detector - no threshold or ratio to set, unlike a compressor.
column2: 通过快/慢包络差检测器，分别提升或削减信号的瞬态敲击（attack）与其持续主体（sustain）——无需设置阈值或比率，这与压缩器不同。

column1: Broadcasts video, 3D renders, or visual shaders to other Windows applications in real-time via Spout, zero-copy GPU texture sharing.
column2: 通过 Spout 以零拷贝 GPU 纹理共享，将视频、3D 渲染或视觉着色器实时广播到其他 Windows 应用程序。

column1: Broadcasts video, 3D renders, or visual shaders to other macOS applications in real-time via zero-copy GPU texture sharing.
column2: 通过零拷贝 GPU 纹理共享，将视频、3D 渲染或视觉着色器实时广播到其他 macOS 应用程序。

column1: Builds an isosurface (blobby, merging spheres) from a point cloud source, or from a manually-placed set of balls when no cloud is patched in.
column2: 从点云来源构建等值面（团块状、相互融合的球体）；未接入点云时，则由手动放置的一组球构建。

column1: Bypass Selection
column2: 旁路所选内容

column1: Camera is a 3D viewpoint patched into Render 3D's camera input. Light is a scene light - Render 3D reads up to three, and ignores any beyond that.
column2: Camera 是接入 Render 3D 相机输入的 3D 视点。Light 是场景灯光——Render 3D 最多读取三盏，多出的会被忽略。

column1: Canvas & View
column2: 画布与视图

column1: Captures a live camera as an image source - built-in, USB webcams and capture devices, through Media Foundation. 'mirror' flips it horizontally, which is usually what you want for a front-facing camera; 'resolution' picks the capture format. Windows will ask for camera permission the first time this node cooks, so it stays idle until it is actually in a patch.
column2: 通过 Media Foundation 捕获实时摄像头作为图像源——内置摄像头、USB 网络摄像头和采集设备。“mirror”水平翻转，这通常正是前置摄像头所需要的；“resolution”选择采集格式。此节点第一次运算时 Windows 会请求摄像头权限，因此在真正进入补丁之前它保持空闲。

column1: Captures a live camera as an image source - the built-in camera, external USB webcams, and Continuity Camera (an iPhone used as a webcam). 'mirror' flips it horizontally, which is usually what you want for a front-facing camera; 'resolution' picks the capture format. macOS will prompt for camera permission the first time this node cooks, so it stays idle until it is actually in a patch.
column2: 捕获实时摄像头作为图像源——内置摄像头、外接 USB 网络摄像头和连续互通相机（把 iPhone 用作网络摄像头）。“mirror”水平翻转，这通常正是前置摄像头所需要的；“resolution”选择采集格式。此节点第一次运算时 macOS 会请求摄像头权限，因此在真正进入补丁之前它保持空闲。

column1: Captures a live camera as an image source via V4L2 - built-in, USB webcams and capture devices. 'mirror' flips it horizontally, which is usually what you want for a front-facing camera; 'resolution' picks the capture format. The device is opened the first time this node cooks, so it stays idle until it is actually in a patch.
column2: 通过 V4L2 捕获实时摄像头作为图像源——内置摄像头、USB 网络摄像头和采集设备。“mirror”水平翻转，这通常正是前置摄像头所需要的；“resolution”选择采集格式。设备在此节点第一次运算时打开，因此在真正进入补丁之前它保持空闲。

column1: Captures the default input device (mic or line-in) as a live audio source for the effects graph - patch it into a Filter, Delay, Mixer or straight to Audio Out. Trim is a plain gain stage; the mic tap starts the first time this node cooks and macOS will prompt for microphone permission then, so it stays idle until it's actually in a patch. The capture runs on its own engine bound to the system default input, independently of whichever output device is selected, and the header line says why it isn't live when it isn't.
column2: 将默认输入设备（麦克风或线路输入）捕获为效果图的实时音频源——可接入 Filter、Delay、Mixer，或直接接到 Audio Out。Trim 是简单的增益级；麦克风分接在此节点第一次运算时启动，届时 macOS 会请求麦克风权限，因此在真正进入补丁之前它保持空闲。采集运行在绑定到系统默认输入的独立引擎上，与所选输出设备无关，未处于实时状态时标题行会说明原因。

column1: Carries up to eight geometry inputs through one pin into Render 3D (or into another Group 3D), so a scene is not limited to Render 3D's four geometry pins. Nothing is merged: each input keeps its own material, texture, mapping and transform. It only means something to Render 3D - use Join Geometry to combine meshes into one.
column2: 通过一个引脚把最多八个几何体输入送入 Render 3D（或另一个 Group 3D），使场景不再受限于 Render 3D 的四个几何体引脚。不会合并任何东西：每个输入保留自己的材质、纹理、映射和变换。它只对 Render 3D 有意义——要把网格合并为一个，请使用 Join Geometry。

column1: Chain a Math node off two LFOs at different rates to get slow drifting motion.
column2: 把一个 Math 节点接到两个不同速率的 LFO 上，即可得到缓慢漂移的运动。

column1: Chops a sample into slices and maps them chromatically to the keyboard from MIDI note 36 upward - note 36 plays slice 1, 37 plays slice 2, and so on. A note past the last slice is silent; it does not wrap round to slice 1. Load a file (or drag one in from the Samples panel), or record from the audio input pin. slice by picks where the boundaries come from: onsets runs transient detection over the sample on a background thread, grid divides it arithmetically at the *global transport tempo* (there is no per-node bpm - change the tempo and the grid follows). sensitivity is the detection threshold and is the only control that re-runs the analysis; onsets just caps the result to the strongest N, and division/slice by recompute boundaries instantly. Click a slice band in the waveform to audition it, and in onsets mode drag any marker to move a boundary by hand - hand-edited markers are saved with the patch. Two separate controls decide how long a slice lasts: crossthrough sets whether playback may run PAST the slice's own next onset (off by default - each slice stops where the next begins), while decay shapes only the amplitude envelope, reading 'hold' at the top of its throw where the slice stays at full level. So: crossthrough off + hold is the classic tight chop; crossthrough off + a decay ends at whichever comes first; crossthrough on + hold plays through the rest of the sample; crossthrough on + a decay is a one-shot with a tail over the rest of the break. attack extends each slice's own fade-in from instant up to half a second.
column2: 把采样切成若干片段，并从 MIDI 音符 36 起按半音阶映射到键盘——音符 36 播放片段 1，37 播放片段 2，依此类推。超出最后一个片段的音符保持静音，不会回绕到片段 1。载入文件（或从 Samples 面板拖入一个），或从音频输入引脚录音。slice by 选择边界的来源：onsets 在后台线程上对采样做瞬态检测，grid 按*全局传输速度*做算术等分（节点没有独立的 bpm——改变速度，网格随之改变）。sensitivity 是检测阈值，也是唯一会重新运行分析的控件；onsets 只是把结果限制为最强的 N 个，division/slice by 会立即重新计算边界。点击波形中的片段色带可试听，在 onsets 模式下拖动任意标记可手动移动边界——手动编辑的标记会随补丁保存。有两个独立的控件决定片段持续多久：crossthrough 决定回放能否越过该片段自身的下一个起音（默认关闭——每个片段在下一个开始处停止），而 decay 只塑造振幅包络，在行程顶端显示“hold”，此时片段保持满电平。因此：crossthrough 关 + hold 是经典的紧凑切片；crossthrough 关 + 某个 decay 以先到者为准结束；crossthrough 开 + hold 会播放采样的其余部分；crossthrough 开 + 某个 decay 是在 break 其余部分上带尾巴的单次播放。attack 把每个片段自身的淡入从瞬时延长到最多半秒。

column1: Chunks the image into flat colour blocks. Block Size sets how large each block is.
column2: 把图像切分为平面色块。Block Size 设置每个色块的大小。

column1: Classic Sobel edge detection: outputs the gradient magnitude as greyscale edges. Invert flips black and white.
column2: 经典 Sobel 边缘检测：将梯度幅值输出为灰度边缘。Invert 交换黑白。

column1: Clear
column2: 清除

column1: Click a node, then Tab loops through that node's parameters (Shift+Tab goes backwards). Digits type a value; Esc leaves
column2: 点击一个节点，然后用 Tab 循环浏览该节点的参数（Shift+Tab 反向）。数字键输入数值；Esc 退出

column1: Click a node, then the arrow keys move it one grid step. With a param focused they nudge the value instead
column2: 点击一个节点，然后方向键将其移动一个网格步长。参数获得焦点时，方向键改为微调数值

column1: Click the cable, then press X
column2: 点击线缆，然后按 X

column1: Colour from a photo
column2: 从照片取色

column1: Combines images, or otherwise manages how they flow through the patch - including colour, mask, and feedback/loop nodes. See Menu > Help > Module reference for the full family.
column2: 合并图像，或以其他方式管理它们在补丁中的流向——包括颜色、遮罩以及反馈/循环节点。完整系列请参见 Menu > Help > Module reference。

column1: Combines two modulators - add, subtract, multiply, divide, min, max, average, difference - with gain and offset. Unpatched inputs fall back to a constant, shown as an editable slider; a patched input just shows as 'patched'.
column2: 组合两个调制器——加、减、乘、除、最小值、最大值、平均值、差值——并带增益和偏移。未连接的输入回退到常量，显示为可编辑的滑块；已连接的输入只显示“patched”。

column1: Combines two modulators - add, subtract, multiply, divide, min, max, average, difference - with gain and offset. Unpatched inputs fall back to a constant.
column2: 组合两个调制器——加、减、乘、除、最小值、最大值、平均值、差值——并带增益和偏移。未连接的输入回退到常量。

column1: Combines two or more geometry inputs into one. The boolean modes (Union, Difference, Intersection, etc, each also spawnable as its own named node) need closed, manifold solids to produce a clean result - open surfaces can give garbage.
column2: 把两个或更多几何体输入合并为一个。布尔模式（Union、Difference、Intersection 等，每种也可作为独立的命名节点生成）需要封闭的流形实体才能得到干净的结果——开放曲面可能产生乱码般的结果。

column1: Converts a note stream's pitch into a modulator, so which note is playing can drive any parameter - a filter cutoff, a warp amount, pan. It is a pitch tracker, not an envelope: it holds the last note's pitch on release rather than falling back toward 0 (that's Envelope's job). rangeLow/High set which note range maps onto the full 0..1 span, glide smooths the jump between notes.
column2: 将音符流的音高转换为调制器，使正在演奏的音符可以驱动任何参数——滤波器截止频率、扭曲量、声像。它是音高跟踪器而非包络：松开时保持最后一个音符的音高，而不是回落到 0（那是 Envelope 的工作）。rangeLow/High 设置哪个音符范围映射到完整的 0..1 区间，glide 平滑音符之间的跳变。

column1: Converts an image into a 3D point cloud - brightness/depth-source drives per-point depth, with density, threshold, point size and optional colour-from-image.
column2: 把图像转换为 3D 点云——亮度/深度来源驱动每个点的深度，带密度、阈值、点大小以及可选的取自图像的颜色。

column1: Converts audio into a modulator through an amplitude follower - Peak or RMS detection with its own attack and release. The lightweight, single-output counterpart of Audio Analyze: reach for this when all you want is 'this parameter follows how loud that is', and for Audio Analyze when you want bands, onsets and a passthrough.
column2: 通过振幅跟随器将音频转换为调制器——峰值或 RMS 检测，带独立的启动和释放。它是 Audio Analyze 的轻量单输出版本：只想要“这个参数跟随那个有多响”时用它，需要频段、起音和直通时用 Audio Analyze。

column1: Converts between premultiplied alpha (colour already scaled by its own alpha) and straight alpha. Only reach for this when something looks wrong at the edges: dark fringing on a composite usually means straight alpha needs premultiplying, bright halos the reverse.
column2: 在预乘 Alpha（颜色已被自身 Alpha 缩放）与直通 Alpha 之间转换。只有在边缘看起来不对时才使用：合成上出现暗色边缘通常说明直通 Alpha 需要预乘，亮色光晕则相反。

column1: Converts how hard each note is played into a modulator (its 0..1 velocity), so touch can drive any parameter - brightness, pan, a filter opening on accents. It holds the last note's velocity through release. range low/high pick which velocities map onto the full 0..1 span (swap them to invert). The pitch counterpart is Note to CV.
column2: 将每个音符的弹奏力度转换为调制器（其 0..1 的力度），使触键可以驱动任何参数——亮度、声像、重音处滤波器的开启。它在释放期间保持最后一个音符的力度。range low/high 选择哪些力度映射到完整的 0..1 区间（互换两者即可反相）。音高方面的对应节点是 Note to CV。

column1: Converts to pure black or white based on luminance, split at Threshold.
column2: 根据亮度转换为纯黑或纯白，以 Threshold 为分界。

column1: Created with {mod}+G on a selection, not spawned from the palette. Sizes itself automatically to fit its members - drag a node in to grow the box, drag one out to shrink it. Drag anywhere inside the box to move the whole group; right-click > Ungroup (or {mod}+U, {mod}+Shift+G) dissolves it, leaving members in place (or ungroup one member from its own context menu).
column2: 在选区上按 {mod}+G 创建，而不是从调色板中生成。它会自动调整大小以容纳其成员——把节点拖入以扩大方框，拖出以缩小。在方框内任意位置拖动可移动整个组；右键 > Ungroup（或 {mod}+U、{mod}+Shift+G）解散它，成员保留在原位（也可从某个成员自己的右键菜单中将其单独解组）。

column1: Crops in from each edge (Left/Right/Top/Bottom). 'outside' chooses what happens to the cropped-away area: stays transparent, the kept region zooms to fill the frame, or gets replaced with a Fill colour.
column2: 从每条边向内裁剪（Left/Right/Top/Bottom）。“outside”选择被裁掉区域的处理方式：保持透明、保留区域放大以填满画面，或替换为 Fill 颜色。

column1: Cut every selected clip the playhead passes through
column2: 切割播放头经过的每个所选剪辑

column1: Cycles between its connected inputs every N beats or seconds, with an optional crossfade. Can be pinned to one input with 'manual'.
column2: 每 N 拍或每 N 秒在已连接的输入之间循环切换，可选交叉渐变。可用“manual”固定到某一个输入。

column1: Cycles between up to four connected geometry inputs every N beats or seconds, forwarding whichever one is active. Can be pinned to one input with 'manual'. Unlike the 2D Switcher, there is no crossfade - it always hard-cuts, since interpolating between two arbitrary meshes' topology isn't generally well-defined.
column2: 每 N 拍或每 N 秒在最多四个已连接的几何体输入之间循环切换，转发当前激活的那个。可用“manual”固定到某一个输入。与 2D Switcher 不同，这里没有交叉渐变——始终硬切，因为在两个任意网格的拓扑之间插值通常没有明确定义。

column1: Cycles between up to four connected note inputs every N beats or seconds, or pins to one slot with 'manual' - the note-cable counterpart of Switcher (2D) and Switcher 3D. When the active slot changes, new note-ons come only from the new slot, while notes already held on the old one still get their note-offs passed through, so nothing hangs.
column2: 每 N 拍或每 N 秒在最多四个已连接的音符输入之间循环切换，或用“manual”固定到某个槽位——是 Switcher (2D) 和 Switcher 3D 的音符线缆版本。当激活的槽位改变时，新的 note-on 只来自新槽位，而旧槽位上已按住的音符仍会照常传递其 note-off，因此不会出现悬挂音。

column1: Darkens the image toward the edges, framing the centre. Radius and Softness shape the falloff, Center X/Y offsets it.
column2: 向边缘压暗图像，突出中心。Radius 和 Softness 决定衰减形状，Center X/Y 对其偏移。

column1: Deforms 3D vertex geometries in real-time driven by live audio frequencies or RMS waveforms.
column2: 由实时音频频率或 RMS 波形驱动，实时变形 3D 顶点几何体。

column1: Deforms a geometry input using live audio patched into its second pin - five modes, each a different physical reading of the same signal: Normal Waveform pushes each vertex along its own normal by the oscilloscope trace, Spectral Bands maps the FFT across the X/U axis, Acoustic Ripples sends concentric waves out from the centre, Cymatics (Chladni) solves the standing-wave modal pattern for mode numbers m/n (the classic salt-on-a-plate figures), and Directional Axis pushes along a fixed local X/Y/Z. Attack/decay shape how fast the surface answers; Subdivide adds the resolution a displacement needs to be visible at all.
column2: 用接入第二个引脚的实时音频使几何体输入变形——五种模式，每种都是对同一信号的不同物理解读：Normal Waveform 按示波器轨迹沿每个顶点自身的法线推动，Spectral Bands 把 FFT 映射到 X/U 轴，Acoustic Ripples 从中心发出同心波，Cymatics (Chladni) 求解模式数 m/n 的驻波模态图样（经典的板上撒盐图形），Directional Axis 沿固定的局部 X/Y/Z 推动。Attack/decay 决定表面响应的快慢；Subdivide 提供位移要变得可见所需的分辨率。

column1: Derives a new alpha channel from the image's own brightness, so a black background becomes transparent with nothing to key against. 'invert' flips which end is solid, for a white-on-black source.
column2: 从图像自身的亮度派生出新的 Alpha 通道，使黑色背景变为透明，无需抠像对象。“invert”翻转哪一端为实心，适用于黑底白字的来源。

column1: Derives a tangent-space normal map from the image's luminance treated as a height field, for use as a bump/normal input elsewhere. 'output' can show the raw Normals, the source Height, or the gradient's Slope instead.
column2: 把图像亮度当作高度场，派生出切线空间法线贴图，可在别处用作凹凸/法线输入。“output”也可以改为显示原始 Normals、源 Height 或梯度的 Slope。

column1: Detects edges via a luminance gradient and draws them as flat-Colour outlines at a chosen Thickness and Threshold, over the original image.
column2: 通过亮度梯度检测边缘，并以所选的 Thickness 和 Threshold 将其绘制为纯 Colour 轮廓，叠加在原图上。

column1: Displaces a geometry's vertices along their normals using a texture's luminance. Needs both a geometry input and a texture input to do anything.
column2: 用纹理的亮度沿法线位移几何体的顶点。需要同时有几何体输入和纹理输入才会起作用。

column1: Displaces pixels outward from a centre in concentric waves. Amplitude is wave height, Wavelength the spacing, Phase animates it.
column2: 将像素从中心向外按同心波位移。Amplitude 为波高，Wavelength 为间距，Phase 使其产生动画。

column1: Duplicates the input mesh in a line or radial ring. Count sets how many copies; radial mode spaces them by Radius, linear mode by Offset X/Y/Z; each copy can additionally rotate/scale a step further than the last.
column2: 将输入网格复制排成一条直线或径向环。Count 设置副本数量；径向模式按 Radius 间隔，线性模式按 Offset X/Y/Z 间隔；每个副本还可以比上一个再多旋转/缩放一步。

column1: Each generation reads the previous one, so the image drifts away from the source. The XY pad blends four named mutation effects assigned to its corners - drag the orb to mix them. Randomise re-rolls which four effects sit in the corners, and the orb's path can be recorded, looped and replayed in time.
column2: 每一代都读取上一代，因此图像会逐渐偏离来源。XY 控制板混合分配在四个角上的四种命名变异效果——拖动球体即可混合。Randomise 会重新随机决定哪四种效果位于角上，球体的轨迹可以录制、循环并按时间回放。

column1: Each generation reads the previous one, so the image drifts away from the source. The XY pad blends four named mutation effects assigned to its corners; Randomise re-rolls which four. The orb's path can be recorded, looped and replayed in time.
column2: 每一代都读取上一代，因此图像会逐渐偏离来源。XY 控制板混合分配在四个角上的四种命名变异效果；Randomise 会重新随机决定是哪四种。球体的轨迹可以录制、循环并按时间回放。

column1: Every slider has a small dot to its left. Patch a modulator into that dot and the slider turns amber and becomes read-only - the value is now being driven. Delete the cable to take manual control back.
column2: 每个滑块左侧都有一个小圆点。把调制器接到这个圆点上，滑块就会变成琥珀色并变为只读——此时数值正被驱动。删除线缆即可收回手动控制。

column1: Exposure, invert, posterize and threshold. Brightness/contrast, levels, HSL, colour balance and channel mixer no longer exist as standalone nodes - they are all sections of Color Adjustments now.
column2: 曝光、反相、色调分离和阈值。亮度/对比度、色阶、HSL、色彩平衡和通道混合器不再作为独立节点存在——它们现在都是 Color Adjustments 的各个部分。

column1: External hardware MIDI controller input, note record, and polyphonic voice dispatch. Note cables carry pitch/velocity/gate, not audio - they end at a synth.
column2: 外部硬件 MIDI 控制器输入、音符录制和复音声部分配。音符线缆传送音高/力度/门控，而不是音频——它们终止于合成器。

column1: Extracts level, band and onset values from audio for modulation - patch any audio source into it (Audio In, Audio File, a Filter, a Mixer, an Oscillator) and every output can drive any slider in the graph. With nothing patched in it falls back to its own Start listening button, a live tap on the system's default input device. It passes its input straight through, so it can sit inline in a chain as well as hang off one as a tap. Outputs: level, low/mid/high, onset, and b1-b8, eight raw frequency bands running low to high.
column2: 从音频中提取电平、频段和起音值用于调制——接入任意音频源（Audio In、Audio File、Filter、Mixer、Oscillator），每个输出都可以驱动图中的任意滑块。未接入任何内容时，它会回退到自带的 Start listening 按钮，即系统默认输入设备的实时分接。它把输入直接透传，因此既可以串联在链中，也可以作为分接挂在链上。输出：level、low/mid/high、onset，以及 b1-b8——从低到高的八个原始频段。

column1: Extreme time-stretching - the PaulStretch algorithm, built for stretch factors where a few seconds becomes minutes of evolving ambient texture rather than a recognisable sample. Large-window FFT with phase randomisation is what keeps it smooth instead of stuttery: at phase randomisation 1 the result is pure texture, lower values keep more of the original's transient character. Also offers spectral pitch shift, frequency shift and unison detune. Load a file or record into its 'record in' pin.
column2: 极端时间拉伸——PaulStretch 算法，专为这样的拉伸倍数而设计：几秒钟变成数分钟不断演变的氛围质感，而不再是可辨认的采样。大窗口 FFT 加相位随机化让结果保持平滑而不是断续：相位随机化为 1 时结果是纯粹的质感，较低的值则保留更多原始的瞬态特征。还提供频谱变调、频移和齐奏失谐。载入文件，或录入其“record in”引脚。

column1: Extreme time-stretching built for factors where seconds become minutes of evolving ambient texture, via large-window FFT with phase randomisation, plus spectral pitch shift, frequency shift and unison detune.
column2: 极端时间拉伸，专为数秒变成数分钟不断演变的氛围质感的倍数而设计，采用大窗口 FFT 加相位随机化，另有频谱变调、频移和齐奏失谐。

column1: Extrudes every face of the input mesh along its own normal by Distance, with Inset shrinking each face first.
column2: 把输入网格的每个面沿自身法线按 Distance 挤出，Inset 会先收缩每个面。

column1: Extrudes only the faces marked by an upstream Select op along their own normals, by Distance, with Inset.
column2: 只把上游 Select 操作标记的面沿自身法线按 Distance 挤出，并带 Inset。

column1: Extrudes text into a 3D mesh, with depth, bevel and letter tracking, using any font installed on the system.
column2: 把文字挤出为 3D 网格，带深度、倒角和字距，可使用系统中安装的任何字体。

column1: FFT spectral domain phase smearing, freeze, and frequency SSB modulation.
column2: FFT 频谱域相位涂抹、冻结和频率 SSB 调制。

column2: Feedback  ->  Blend 输入 B

column1: Five fixed bands (low shelf, three peaks, high shelf by default), each switchable to any of low shelf/peak/high shelf/hp 12/lp 12 and independently on or off. Drag a band's dot on the curve to set its frequency and gain, Shift-drag to set Q, double-click the dot to bypass that band - the knob row below always follows whichever band you last touched.
column2: 五个固定频段（默认为低架、三个峰值、高架），每个都可切换为 low shelf/peak/high shelf/hp 12/lp 12，并可单独开关。在曲线上拖动频段的圆点以设置其频率和增益，Shift+拖动设置 Q，双击圆点可旁路该频段——下方的旋钮行始终跟随你最后触碰的频段。

column1: Five kinds: the original combined glitch, RGB shift, scanlines, blocks, wave and datamosh.
column2: 五种类型：原始的组合故障、RGB 位移、扫描线、块、波浪和 datamosh。

column1: Five-band parametric equalizer - low shelf, three peaks and a high shelf by default, each switchable to shelf / peak / HP12 / LP12 and independently on or off - over an interactive frequency response display. Drag a band's dot for frequency and gain, Shift-drag for Q.
column2: 五段参量均衡器——默认为低架、三个峰值和高架，每段都可切换为 shelf / peak / HP12 / LP12，并可单独开关——配有交互式频率响应显示。拖动频段圆点调整频率和增益，Shift+拖动调整 Q。

column1: Flat-tints the image toward a chosen Colour at a given Opacity.
column2: 以给定的 Opacity 将图像平涂着色为所选的 Colour。

column1: Flows pixels around using animated Perlin-style noise, like a liquid warp. Scale sets the flow's feature size, Speed animates it.
column2: 用动画的 Perlin 式噪声使像素流动，像液体扭曲一样。Scale 设置流动的特征尺寸，Speed 使其产生动画。

column1: Four classic waveforms (sine, triangle, saw, square) with an interactive amp envelope, unison, filter, hard sync and fine/coarse tuning.
column2: 四种经典波形（正弦、三角、锯齿、方波），带交互式振幅包络、齐奏、滤波器、硬同步和精调/粗调。

column1: Four inputs stacked bottom-up: A is the base, D sits on top. Each layer has its own blend mode and opacity, and dragging a layer header reorders the whole layer.
column2: 四个输入自下而上堆叠：A 为底层，D 在最上。每层都有自己的混合模式和不透明度，拖动某层的标题可重新排序整层。

column1: Frame the whole patch in the canvas view
column2: 在画布视图中框选整个补丁

column1: Gaussian, box, motion (angle + distance) and radial (with a centre point).
column2: 高斯、方框、运动（角度+距离）和径向（带中心点）。

column1: Generates a flat rectangular lattice of points from nothing - no geometry input. Count X/Y and Spacing X/Y set the grid, Jitter randomises each point off its cell centre. Ordering matches Image to Points exactly (row-major, cell-centre UV), so a grid and an Image to Points at the same counts line up point-for-point.
column2: 无需任何输入即可生成平面矩形点阵——不需要几何体输入。Count X/Y 和 Spacing X/Y 设定网格，Jitter 使每个点随机偏离其单元中心。排序与 Image to Points 完全一致（按行优先、单元中心 UV），因此相同数量的网格与 Image to Points 逐点对齐。

column1: Generates a gradient from scratch (no input) between up to 8 user-set colour stops, at a chosen angle, scale and offset. Gamma and dither smooth out visible banding.
column2: 从零生成（无需输入）渐变，包含最多 8 个用户设定的色标，可选角度、缩放和偏移。Gamma 和 dither 可消除明显的色带。

column1: Generates procedural 3D point geometry from scratch using a per-element Field kernel (Circle, Spiral, Grid Lattice, Fibonacci Sphere, Helix, Torus Knot).
column2: 用逐元素的 Field 内核从零生成程序化 3D 点几何体（Circle、Spiral、Grid Lattice、Fibonacci Sphere、Helix、Torus Knot）。

column1: Geometry covers 24 primitives (plane, cube, sphere, icosphere, torus, cylinder, cone, torus knot, capsule, tube, pyramid, prism, helix, supershape, the platonic solids, rounded cube, Mobius strip, Klein bottle, gear, star, disc, arrow), each also spawnable by name. Plus Model 3D (obj, ply, stl, usd, usdz), Text 3D, Curve, Ocean and Metaballs.
column2: Geometry 涵盖 24 种基本体（plane、cube、sphere、icosphere、torus、cylinder、cone、torus knot、capsule、tube、pyramid、prism、helix、supershape、各柏拉图立体、rounded cube、Mobius strip、Klein bottle、gear、star、disc、arrow），每种也都可按名称生成。另有 Model 3D（obj、ply、stl、usd、usdz）、Text 3D、Curve、Ocean 和 Metaballs。

column1: Gives a flat or open surface real Thickness, turning it into a solid shell. 'keep original' also retains the source surface.
column2: 为平面或开放曲面赋予真实的 Thickness，使其成为实体外壳。“keep original”还会保留原始曲面。

column1: Grades the image through a second patched-in HALD/strip LUT image - an N x N-sliced colour cube encoded as a flat strip. LUT Size must match the LUT image's slice count, Mix blends with the original.
column2: 通过接入的第二张 HALD/条带 LUT 图像对画面调色——一个 N x N 切片的色彩立方体，编码为平面条带。LUT Size 必须与 LUT 图像的切片数一致，Mix 与原图混合。

column1: Granular synthesis over a loaded or recorded sample: grain length and density set the texture, position/scan and freeze set where the cloud reads from, and the random position/length/pitch/pan controls plus reverse probability are what make it a cloud rather than a stutter.
column2: 基于已载入或已录制采样的粒子合成：颗粒长度和密度决定质感，position/scan 和 freeze 决定颗粒云从哪里读取，而位置/长度/音高/声像的随机控制加上反向概率，才使它成为一团颗粒云而不是结巴。

column1: Gray-Scott chemical simulation, six presets. Needs no input; patch one in and its luminance varies the feed rate so the pattern grows differently through light and dark.
column2: Gray-Scott 化学模拟，六个预设。无需输入；接入一个后，其亮度会改变进料速率，使图案在明暗区域以不同方式生长。

column2: 编组 / 取消编组剪辑

column2: Group 将整组和零散剪辑合并为一个；Ungroup 解散所有涉及的组

column1: Halftone (mono or CMY-style colour), Sobel edge detection and Edge Outline.
column2: 半色调（单色或 CMY 风格彩色）、Sobel 边缘检测和 Edge Outline。

column2: 隐藏 / 显示参数

column1: High-resolution multi-sample player with pitch tracking, root note detection, start/end trimming, loop crossfades, and one-shot playback.
column2: 高分辨率多采样播放器，带音高跟踪、根音检测、起止裁剪、循环交叉渐变和单次触发播放。

column1: Hold to pan the canvas up / left / down / right. Not while a hovered audio keyboard node is using the letters
column2: 按住可向上 / 向左 / 向下 / 向右平移画布。悬停的音频键盘节点正在使用这些字母时无效

column1: Holds whatever notes are currently down and replays them one at a time on its own clock, either synced to tempo (a note division) or free-running in seconds. Up/Down/Up-Down/Down-Up/As Played order the held notes by pitch or by the order they were pressed; Converge alternates outside-in (lowest, highest, next-lowest...), Diverge alternates inside-out from the middle; Random picks one per step. Repeat x2/x4 fires each note 2 or 4 times in a row before advancing. Stairs Up/Down walks the pattern in overlapping two-note steps (C E, E G, G C...). Join and Spread only differ once octaves is above 1: Spread stacks the pattern octave-by-octave (C3 D3 E3, C4 D4 E4), Join interleaves each note's octaves together (C3 C4, D3 D4, E3 E4), and Join/Spread alternates between the two every full pass - at octaves = 1 all three play identically to Up. The 8-step gate grid below the readout is the primary control: click or drag across cells to mute individual steps without changing the note order (advancing past a muted step still moves the pattern forward, punching a rhythmic hole rather than skipping a note), and the lit cell tracks the currently-sounding step. Octaves stacks the pattern up to 4 octaves higher. Gate sets how much of each step the note actually sounds for before its off. Preset loads a complete starting point (mode, octaves, rate, gate and gate pattern) in one click.
column2: 保持当前按下的音符，并用自己的时钟逐个重播——可同步到速度（音符分割），也可按秒自由运行。Up/Down/Up-Down/Down-Up/As Played 按音高或按下顺序排列按住的音符；Converge 由外向内交替（最低、最高、次低……），Diverge 从中间向外交替；Random 每步随机选一个。Repeat x2/x4 在前进之前把每个音符连续触发 2 次或 4 次。Stairs Up/Down 以重叠的两音步进走过该模式（C E、E G、G C……）。Join 和 Spread 只有在 octaves 大于 1 时才有区别：Spread 逐个八度堆叠模式（C3 D3 E3、C4 D4 E4），Join 把每个音符的各个八度交织在一起（C3 C4、D3 D4、E3 E4），Join/Spread 则在每次完整走完后在两者之间交替——octaves = 1 时三者的演奏与 Up 完全相同。读数下方的 8 步门控网格是主要控制：点击或拖过单元格可让单个步骤静音，而不改变音符顺序（越过静音步骤仍会推进模式，造成节奏上的空洞，而不是跳过一个音符），亮起的单元格跟随当前发声的步骤。Octaves 最多把模式向上堆叠 4 个八度。Gate 设定每一步中音符在关闭前实际发声的比例。Preset 一键载入完整的起点（模式、octaves、rate、gate 和门控图案）。

column1: Hosts a third-party Audio Unit effect. Drag one in from the Plugins panel (Rescan there indexes what is installed; the list is cached, so launching never rescans), or drop a .component bundle from Finder. "open" shows the plugin's own editor in a separate window. The sliders on the body are plugin parameters you chose to expose: turn "configure" on and touch a control in the plugin's own window and it appears here as a mapped row - or pick one from the dropdown, since not every plugin's editor tells the host what was touched. Each mapped row is a real param with its own modulation pin, so a Ramp or Envelope can drive it. Right-click a row to unmap it. With nothing loaded, or bypassed, audio passes through unchanged.
column2: 托管第三方 Audio Unit 效果器。可从 Plugins 面板拖入一个（那里的 Rescan 会索引已安装的内容；列表有缓存，所以启动时从不重新扫描），或从 Finder 拖入 .component 包。“open”会在单独的窗口中显示插件自己的编辑器。节点主体上的滑块是你选择暴露的插件参数：打开“configure”并在插件自己的窗口中触碰某个控件，它就会作为映射行出现在这里——或者从下拉菜单中选择一个，因为并非每个插件编辑器都会告诉宿主触碰了什么。每个映射行都是带有自己调制引脚的真实参数，因此 Ramp 或 Envelope 可以驱动它。右键单击某一行可取消映射。未载入任何内容或被旁路时，音频原样通过。

column1: Hosts third-party Audio Unit and VST3 effects, with full state save/restore and parameter automation through mapped modulation pins. The plugin's own editor opens in its own native window.
column2: 托管第三方 Audio Unit 和 VST3 效果器，支持完整的状态保存/恢复，并通过映射的调制引脚实现参数自动化。插件自己的编辑器在其原生窗口中打开。

column1: Hosts third-party VST3 effects, with full state save/restore and parameter automation through mapped modulation pins. The plugin's own editor opens in its own X11 window. Audio Units are a macOS-only format and are not available here.
column2: 托管第三方 VST3 效果器，支持完整的状态保存/恢复，并通过映射的调制引脚实现参数自动化。插件自己的编辑器在其自己的 X11 窗口中打开。Audio Unit 是仅限 macOS 的格式，在此不可用。

column1: Hosts third-party VST3 effects, with full state save/restore and parameter automation through mapped modulation pins. The plugin's own editor opens in its own native window. Audio Units are a macOS-only format and are not available here.
column2: 托管第三方 VST3 效果器，支持完整的状态保存/恢复，并通过映射的调制引脚实现参数自动化。插件自己的编辑器在其原生窗口中打开。Audio Unit 是仅限 macOS 的格式，在此不可用。

column2: 如何

column1: How to use: wire the out into Audio Out, drop audio files onto the pads (or click an empty pad, or Load... / Folder... for the first 16 files of a folder), then click a pad or send notes into the notes input - notes 36 to 51 play pads 1 to 16. A 16-pad sample player: pad 1 is bottom-left like a hardware MPC, every pad is a square tile showing its waveform, number and mode, and each pad has its own CV pin, so a MIDI CC / Note modulator or any gate can play it. Every pad is its own voice, so pads play together, and a click plays at once. A hit follows the pad's mode: one shot plays the whole sample and a new hit restarts it; gate plays while held (mouse down, CV high or note held) and stops on release; loop toggles a looping playback on each hit. Click selects a pad (right-click selects without playing); the rows below the pads edit the selected pad: sync and rate, fine tune (cents), pitch (semitones), speed (negative plays backwards), volume, pan, mode, and fade in / fade out (ms, at the start and end of every pass), defined as on the Sampler. sync is per pad: Free (the default) plays a hit at once; Synced latches the hit and fires it on the next grid line of the transport at the chosen rate (1/4, 1/8, 1 bar ... the same divisions as every other node), sample-accurately; a hit on the line itself fires on it, with the transport stopped it fires at once, and in gate mode letting go before the line cancels the hit. In loop mode a synced pad re-triggers the sample on every division while it is on (one pass per division: a longer sample is cut at the line, a shorter one leaves a gap), and with the transport stopped it plays as a plain loop. The rate control is greyed while a pad is Free. Every param of every pad can be modulated at any time: a cable stays bound to its own pad when you select another pad, and an orange dot on a tile shows that pad has a modulated param. A tile shows the mode and, when synced, the rate. The node's audio out is the mix of all pads. Loaded sample paths and pad settings are saved with the patch; the audio is re-read on load.
column2: 使用方法：把输出接到 Audio Out，把音频文件拖到鼓垫上（或点击空鼓垫，或用 Load... / Folder... 载入文件夹中的前 16 个文件），然后点击鼓垫或向音符输入发送音符——音符 36 到 51 对应鼓垫 1 到 16。这是一个 16 鼓垫的采样播放器：鼓垫 1 位于左下角，如同硬件 MPC，每个鼓垫都是一个方形图块，显示其波形、编号和模式，并且每个鼓垫都有自己的 CV 引脚，因此 MIDI CC / Note 调制器或任何门控都可以触发它。每个鼓垫都是独立的声部，因此鼓垫可以同时发声，点击会立即发声。一次触发遵循鼓垫的模式：one shot 播放整个采样，新的触发会使其重新开始；gate 在按住时播放（鼠标按下、CV 为高或音符按住），松开时停止；loop 每次触发切换一次循环播放。点击选择鼓垫（右键选择但不发声）；鼓垫下方的各行编辑所选鼓垫：sync 和 rate、fine tune（音分）、pitch（半音）、speed（负值为倒放）、volume、pan、mode，以及 fade in / fade out（毫秒，位于每次播放的开头和结尾），定义与 Sampler 相同。sync 是按鼓垫设置的：Free（默认）立即播放触发；Synced 锁存触发，并在传输的下一个网格线、按所选 rate（1/4、1/8、1 bar……与其他所有节点相同的分割）以采样级精度触发；恰好落在线上的触发在线上触发，传输停止时立即触发，在 gate 模式下于线之前松开会取消该触发。在 loop 模式下，同步鼓垫在开启期间每个分割都会重新触发采样（每个分割一次播放：较长的采样在线处被截断，较短的会留下间隙），传输停止时则作为普通循环播放。当鼓垫为 Free 时，rate 控件显示为灰色。每个鼓垫的每个参数都可随时调制：选择另一个鼓垫时，线缆仍绑定在其自己的鼓垫上，图块上的橙色圆点表示该鼓垫有被调制的参数。图块显示模式，同步时还显示 rate。节点的音频输出是所有鼓垫的混合。已载入的采样路径和鼓垫设置随补丁保存；音频在载入时重新读取。

column1: How to use: wire the sound to loop into the input and the out to Audio Out, press Rec (with the transport playing and sync on it waits for the next bar; pressed up to 200 ms late, the take still starts on the line just passed), and the take ends by itself after the take length, then loops; Play stops and restarts it, Dub layers what comes in over it, Clear empties it. The waveform shows the loop with a playhead and the beat grid, and the line under the title says what the looper is doing. Each button has a CV pin, so a footswitch or MIDI note can drive them (a rising edge presses). take sets the length: a musical division (1 bar by default), or free, where the next Rec press ends it. Pressing Dub while recording ends the take and goes straight into overdub. Undo steps back one layer at a time (the last take, overdub or Clear, up to 8 steps) and the loop keeps playing; pressed during an overdub it throws that layer away. Playback has the Sampler's controls: finetune (cents), pitch (semitones), speed (negative plays backwards), volume, and fade in / fade out (ms) at the start and end of every pass. At exactly 1.00x the loop stays on the grid; at any other rate it plays in length / rate and DRIFTS against the transport, and Dub is paused while it does (layers are only written at the rate they were recorded). thru monitors the live input. Each take is always shifted by the audio interface's measured round-trip latency, so a loop played in time sits on the grid. The loop (up to 60 s) is saved as a WAV in your Recordings folder and comes back, stopped, when the patch is opened.
column2: 使用方法：把要循环的声音接到输入，把输出接到 Audio Out，按下 Rec（传输正在播放且开启 sync 时，它会等待下一小节；最多晚按 200 毫秒，这次录音仍从刚刚过去的那条线开始），录音在 take 长度之后自动结束，然后循环播放；Play 使其停止并重新开始，Dub 把输入的内容叠加其上，Clear 将其清空。波形显示带播放头和节拍网格的循环，标题下方的一行说明 looper 当前在做什么。每个按钮都有一个 CV 引脚，因此脚踏开关或 MIDI 音符可以驱动它们（上升沿相当于按下）。take 设定长度：一个音乐分割（默认 1 bar），或 free——此时下一次按 Rec 才会结束它。录音时按 Dub 会结束这次录音并直接进入叠录。Undo 每次后退一层（最近一次录音、叠录或 Clear，最多 8 步），循环保持播放；在叠录期间按下则丢弃该层。回放具有 Sampler 的控制：finetune（音分）、pitch（半音）、speed（负值为倒放）、volume，以及每次播放开头和结尾的 fade in / fade out（毫秒）。恰好为 1.00x 时，循环保持在网格上；其他速率下它按 length / rate 播放并相对传输产生漂移，且此时 Dub 暂停（各层只能以其录制时的速率写入）。thru 监听实时输入。每次录音始终按音频接口测得的往返延迟进行偏移，因此按时演奏的循环会落在网格上。循环（最长 60 秒）以 WAV 保存到你的 Recordings 文件夹，并在打开补丁时以停止状态恢复。

column1: If you just want trails, use the Trails node instead - it is that same loop wrapped into one node, with decay, drift, zoom and rotation built in. Reaction Diffusion is the other pre-wired feedback node: it needs no input at all and simulates a chemical system frame over frame.
column2: 如果你只想要拖尾，请改用 Trails 节点——它就是把同样的环路封装进一个节点，并内置了 decay、drift、zoom 和旋转。Reaction Diffusion 是另一个预先接好线的反馈节点：它完全不需要输入，逐帧模拟一个化学系统。

column1: Image-to-sound additive resynthesis, in the MetaSynth tradition: any image, glyph, drawing or live video patched in is read as a spectrogram and rebuilt out of 64-256 sine partials. X is time (the scan axis), Y is frequency (linear or logarithmic, between min/max Hz), brightness is amplitude, and in Hue-Pan colour mode the hue becomes stereo position. The scan can sync to the transport at a note division, free-run at its own speed, or be scrubbed by hand with position - and with a note cable connected it transposes polyphonically.
column2: MetaSynth 传统的图像转声音加法重合成：接入的任何图像、字形、绘画或实时视频都会被当作频谱图读取，并由 64-256 个正弦分音重建。X 为时间（扫描轴），Y 为频率（线性或对数，介于 min/max Hz 之间），亮度为振幅，在 Hue-Pan 颜色模式下色相变为立体声位置。扫描可以按音符分割同步到传输、以自己的速度自由运行，或用 position 手动擦洗——接上音符线缆后它还能复音移调。

column1: Image-to-spectral additive resynthesis, MetaSynth-style: any image, drawing or live video patched in is read as a spectrogram and rebuilt from 64-256 sine partials - X is time, Y is frequency, brightness is amplitude, and hue can become stereo position.
column2: MetaSynth 风格的图像转频谱加法重合成：接入的任何图像、绘画或实时视频都被当作频谱图读取，并由 64-256 个正弦分音重建——X 为时间，Y 为频率，亮度为振幅，色相可变为立体声位置。
