column1: Inverts every colour channel (alpha untouched) - a photographic negative. No parameters.
column2: 反转每个颜色通道（Alpha 不变）——照片底片效果。无参数。

column1: Isolates pixels above a brightness Threshold, blurs them outward by Radius, and adds the glow back at Intensity - classic HDR-style bloom.
column2: 分离出高于亮度 Threshold 的像素，按 Radius 向外模糊，再以 Intensity 把辉光加回——经典的 HDR 风格泛光。

column1: Iteratively averages each vertex toward its neighbours (a Laplacian smooth) - Iterations and Strength control how much it relaxes. On a low-poly mesh like a Cube there's no extra geometry between the corners to round out, so raise Pre-subdivide first to see rounded edges.
column2: 迭代地把每个顶点向其相邻顶点取平均（拉普拉斯平滑）——Iterations 和 Strength 控制其松弛程度。在 Cube 这样的低多边形网格上，角点之间没有额外的几何体可供圆滑，因此请先提高 Pre-subdivide 才能看到圆角边缘。

column1: Jump the playhead to the previous or next marker
column2: 将播放头跳到上一个或下一个标记

column1: Keys out a brightness range (Low-High) instead of a colour, with Softness at the edges and Invert to flip which range is kept. 'show: Matte' previews the alpha.
column2: 抠除亮度范围（Low-High）而不是颜色，边缘带 Softness，Invert 可翻转保留哪个范围。“show: Matte”预览 Alpha。

column1: Layer-effect style filters.
column2: 图层效果风格的滤镜。

column1: Layers transposed copies of every incoming note on top of the original - eight independent semitone voices, each switched on or off on its own. The dry note always sounds; the enabled voices are added to it, not instead of it. The set of voices is captured when a note starts, so switching one off mid-note never leaves it hanging.
column2: 在原音符之上叠加每个输入音符的移调副本——八个独立的半音声部，每个都可单独开关。干音符始终发声；启用的声部是叠加在它之上，而不是取代它。声部集合在音符开始时被捕获，因此在音符进行中关闭某个声部绝不会使其悬挂。

column1: Learns a small dynamical model of a single patched-in modulator, then free-runs it on its own once Learn stops.
column2: 学习单个已接入调制器的小型动力学模型，在 Learn 停止后让它自行自由运行。

column1: Learns what 'graded' footage looks like for you and grades incoming frames toward it. Press Learn on already-graded footage to build a target profile (or leave self normalize on to auto-level/contrast without one); mix blends the grade in. Wander makes the grade gently drift among looks the profile has actually seen instead of solving to the exact same answer every frame - 0 is the old fixed behavior, higher wanders more, scaled down automatically for a thin or low-confidence profile.
column2: 学习“已调色”的素材对你而言是什么样子，并把输入帧向该观感调色。在已调色的素材上按 Learn 来建立目标档案（或者保持 self normalize 开启，在没有档案时自动调整电平/对比度）；mix 控制调色的混合量。Wander 使调色在档案实际见过的观感之间轻柔漂移，而不是每一帧都解出完全相同的答案——0 是旧的固定行为，越高漂移越多，对于稀疏或低置信度的档案会自动缩小。

column1: Learns what 'graded' footage looks like for you and grades incoming frames toward it. Press Learn on already-graded footage to build a target profile (or leave self normalize on to auto-level/contrast without one); mix blends the grade in. Wander makes the grade gently drift among looks the profile has actually seen instead of solving to the exact same answer every frame.
column2: 学习“已调色”的素材对你而言是什么样子，并把输入帧向该观感调色。在已调色的素材上按 Learn 来建立目标档案（或者保持 self normalize 开启，在没有档案时自动调整电平/对比度）；mix 控制调色的混合量。Wander 使调色在档案实际见过的观感之间轻柔漂移，而不是每一帧都解出完全相同的答案。

column1: Learns where you leave a knob and how you move it, then continues, settles and wanders like you. Shift-drag a driven knob to correct it.
column2: 学习你把旋钮留在哪里以及如何移动它，然后像你一样继续、稳定并游移。Shift+拖动被驱动的旋钮可进行修正。

column1: Learns where you leave each knob and how fast you move it, then keeps the knob going after you let go, settles it into your usual places and wanders between them at your pace. Speed scales the learned pace, Stray widens or narrows the wandering, Momentum is how long a release carries on, Link lets your live hand activity stir it: quiet knobs wake up while you play and settle when you stop. Shift-drag a driven knob to take over; the dot on the knob shows how much history backs it and the faint marks show where it is likely to go next. Freeze stores the learned profile in the patch.
column2: 学习你把每个旋钮留在哪里以及移动它的快慢，然后在你松手后继续驱动该旋钮，让它稳定在你常用的位置，并以你的节奏在这些位置之间游移。Speed 缩放所学的节奏，Stray 放宽或收窄游移范围，Momentum 是松手后继续运动的时长，Link 让你实时的手部操作来搅动它：安静的旋钮在你演奏时苏醒，停下后又稳定下来。Shift+拖动被驱动的旋钮可接管；旋钮上的圆点显示有多少历史支撑它，淡淡的标记显示它接下来可能去往何处。Freeze 把所学的档案存入补丁。

column1: Listens on a UDP port for Open Sound Control messages matching an address pattern, and reports the last received value as a modulator (remapped through low/high). Behaves like LFO/Random - patch its output onto any slider's modulation pin.
column2: 在 UDP 端口上监听与地址模式匹配的 Open Sound Control 消息，并把最后收到的值作为调制器输出（通过 low/high 重新映射）。行为与 LFO/Random 类似——把它的输出接到任意滑块的调制引脚上。

column1: Live audio looper: record, play, overdub and clear with tempo-synced take lengths and interface latency compensation.
column2: 实时音频循环器：录制、播放、叠录和清除，带与速度同步的录音长度及接口延迟补偿。

column1: Live camera or capture input through AVFoundation - pick a device and a resolution from the node. macOS asks for camera permission the first time. Frames arrive on the device's own clock, so this one source does not pause with the transport.
column2: 通过 AVFoundation 的实时摄像头或采集输入——在节点中选择设备和分辨率。macOS 首次会请求摄像头权限。帧按设备自己的时钟到达，因此这个来源不会随传输暂停。

column1: Live camera or capture input through Media Foundation - pick a device and a resolution from the node. Frames arrive on the device's own clock, so this one source does not pause with the transport.
column2: 通过 Media Foundation 的实时摄像头或采集输入——在节点中选择设备和分辨率。帧按设备自己的时钟到达，因此这个来源不会随传输暂停。

column1: Live camera or capture input through V4L2 (/dev/video*) - pick a device and a resolution from the node. Frames arrive on the device's own clock, so this one source does not pause with the transport.
column2: 通过 V4L2（/dev/video*）的实时摄像头或采集输入——在节点中选择设备和分辨率。帧按设备自己的时钟到达，因此这个来源不会随传输暂停。

column1: Live input from an audio device - the input side of the same engine Audio Out feeds. Choose the device in Settings > Audio.
column2: 来自音频设备的实时输入——与为 Audio Out 供给的是同一个引擎的输入端。在 Settings > Audio 中选择设备。

column1: Loads a 3D model file - obj, ply, stl, usd or usdz.
column2: 载入 3D 模型文件——obj、ply、stl、usd 或 usdz。

column1: Loads a still image. Opens the native file picker and decodes PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TGA and HDR. Platform image codecs vary on Linux, so HEIC and camera RAW are not decoded here - convert them first.
column2: 载入静态图像。打开原生文件选择器，解码 PNG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、TGA 和 HDR。Linux 上的平台图像编解码器各不相同，因此这里不解码 HEIC 和相机 RAW——请先转换。

column1: Loads a still image. Opens the native file picker and decodes anything Windows Imaging Component can read - PNG, JPEG, TIFF, BMP, GIF, HEIF and the camera RAW formats WIC has a codec for.
column2: 载入静态图像。打开原生文件选择器，解码 Windows Imaging Component 能读取的一切——PNG、JPEG、TIFF、BMP、GIF、HEIF，以及 WIC 有编解码器的相机 RAW 格式。

column1: Loads a still image. Opens the native file picker and decodes anything macOS can read - PNG, JPEG, TIFF, HEIC, RAW and more.
column2: 载入静态图像。打开原生文件选择器，解码 macOS 能读取的一切——PNG、JPEG、TIFF、HEIC、RAW 等。

column1: Loads an audio file for playback and Audio Analyze to read. Keeps analysing even while muted - the 'audible' checkbox only controls monitoring.
column2: 载入音频文件用于播放和供 Audio Analyze 读取。即使静音也会持续分析——“audible”复选框只控制监听。

column1: Loads an equirectangular .hdr or .exr image and patches into Render 3D's env input, replacing the fixed sky gradient with a real image for the background and for reflections/ambient light. Rotation turns the image around Y; intensity scales it independently of Render 3D's own env intensity. Reflections use the image's own mip chain scaled by roughness as a cheap stand-in for a proper blurred prefilter - very glossy metal will read a little softer than a full IBL renderer would give it. Use this node rather than Image Source for HDRIs - Image Source clamps to 8-bit sRGB, which throws away exactly the above-1.0 highlight range an HDRI needs.
column2: 载入等距柱状投影的 .hdr 或 .exr 图像，并接入 Render 3D 的 env 输入，用真实图像取代固定的天空渐变，作为背景以及反射/环境光。Rotation 使图像绕 Y 轴旋转；intensity 独立于 Render 3D 自身的 env 强度对其缩放。反射使用图像自身按粗糙度缩放的 mip 链，作为适当模糊预过滤的廉价替代——非常光亮的金属看起来会比完整的 IBL 渲染器略柔和一些。HDRI 请使用此节点而不是 Image Source——Image Source 会钳制为 8 位 sRGB，恰好丢掉 HDRI 所需的高于 1.0 的高光范围。

column1: Macro Knob, Macro Slider, Macro Bipolar Knob, Macro XY, Macro Toggle, Macro Trigger, Macro NumBox, Macro Radio Selector, and Macro Step Gate - unified live performance controls surfaced in the Performance Matrix.
column2: Macro Knob、Macro Slider、Macro Bipolar Knob、Macro XY、Macro Toggle、Macro Trigger、Macro NumBox、Macro Radio Selector 和 Macro Step Gate——统一的现场演出控制，显示在 Performance Matrix 中。

column1: Make the whole interface bigger or smaller in 0.1 steps (0.5x to 2x); same setting as Settings > UI Scale
column2: 以 0.1 为步长放大或缩小整个界面（0.5x 到 2x）；与 Settings > UI Scale 是同一设置

column1: Marks a subset of faces - by index range, position along an axis, normal direction, random chance, or within a radius - for downstream ops (Delete Selected / Transform Selected / Extrude Selected) to act on. Invert flips the selection, 'add to selection' unions with whatever was already selected.
column2: 标记一部分面——按索引范围、沿某轴的位置、法线方向、随机概率或某半径之内——供下游操作（Delete Selected / Transform Selected / Extrude Selected）作用。Invert 反转选择，“add to selection”与已选内容取并集。

column1: Material is the shading block Render 3D reads per slot (base colour, metal/rough, emission, texture inputs). Mapping controls how a texture is projected onto the geometry. HDRI supplies the environment map for reflections and the background.
column2: Material 是 Render 3D 按槽位读取的着色块（基础色、金属/粗糙度、自发光、纹理输入）。Mapping 控制纹理如何投射到几何体上。HDRI 提供用于反射和背景的环境贴图。

column1: Mesh to Points / Edges / Faces, Distribute Points on Faces (area-weighted, random or Poisson), Distribute Points in Grid, Image to Points, Points to Vertices, Set Vertex Color, and Instance on Points to stamp a shape at every point in one instanced call.
column2: Mesh to Points / Edges / Faces、Distribute Points on Faces（按面积加权，随机或 Poisson）、Distribute Points in Grid、Image to Points、Points to Vertices、Set Vertex Color，以及 Instance on Points——用一次实例化调用在每个点上盖印一个形状。

column1: Mid/side width control: width scales the side signal (0 = mono, 1 = unchanged, 2 = exaggerated), pan balances the result, bass mono folds everything below a frequency back to mono so low end survives a mono system. The bar shows live L/R correlation.
column2: 中/侧宽度控制：width 缩放侧信号（0 = 单声道，1 = 不变，2 = 夸张），pan 平衡结果，bass mono 把低于某频率的一切折叠回单声道，使低频在单声道系统上得以保留。条形显示实时 L/R 相关性。

column1: Mirrors a modulator around a low/high pivot. Defaults to 0..1 for a classic 1-v flip; set low/high to match an unclamped source to mirror it correctly.
column2: 围绕 low/high 支点镜像调制器。默认为 0..1，即经典的 1-v 翻转；把 low/high 设为与未钳制的来源相符，才能正确镜像它。

column1: Mirrors a modulator around the midpoint of a low/high window, so what was at the top of the range lands at the bottom. Deliberately not a flat 1-v, which is why it still does the right thing when fed something already outside 0..1 - an unclamped Math output, for instance.
column2: 围绕 low/high 窗口的中点镜像调制器，使原本在范围顶部的值落到底部。有意不做成单纯的 1-v，因此当输入已经超出 0..1 时（例如未钳制的 Math 输出）它仍能做出正确的事。

column1: Mirrors the image about the X axis, Y axis, or both, from a chosen centre point. Flip additionally reverses the whole image before mirroring.
column2: 从选定的中心点出发，沿 X 轴、Y 轴或两者镜像图像。Flip 会在镜像前额外翻转整张图像。

column1: Mirrors the mesh across a plane perpendicular to a chosen Axis, at a given plane offset. 'keep original' keeps the source geometry too, 'weld seam' merges the two halves where they meet.
column2: 将网格沿垂直于所选 Axis 的平面镜像，平面带给定的偏移。“keep original”同时保留原始几何体，“weld seam”在两半相接处将其焊接合并。

column1: Modulate a Switcher's 'every' with an LFO for irregular cutting.
column2: 用 LFO 调制 Switcher 的“every”，实现不规则切换。

column1: Modulate a parameter
column2: 调制参数

column1: Modulation Matrix
column2: 调制矩阵

column1: Modulator rates are given in beats, not seconds. A rate of 4 means one cycle every four beats, so it stays in time when you change the BPM.
column2: 调制器的速率以拍而非秒为单位。rate 为 4 表示每四拍一个周期，因此更改 BPM 时它仍保持同步。

column1: Module reference
column2: 模块参考

column1: Molder decomposes a sample into tracked harmonic partials plus a real residual, then mutates a parameter genome and re-renders from it, each roll walking further from the last. Grain Molder rearranges grains along a blend between original position and a per-grain metric (level, brightness, random).
column2: Molder 把采样分解为被跟踪的谐波分音加上真实残余，然后变异一组参数基因组并据此重新渲染，每次掷骰都比上一次走得更远。Grain Molder 沿着原始位置与逐颗粒度量（电平、亮度、随机）之间的混合重新排列颗粒。

column1: Morphs one sound into another by sliding spectral peaks instead of cross-fading.
column2: 通过滑动频谱峰值而不是交叉渐变，把一个声音变形为另一个。

column1: Morphs the sound into the one on the 'to' pin by sliding its spectral peaks toward the other's positions instead of cross-fading, so a 440 Hz tone becomes 880 Hz by passing through 660 Hz. Slide sets how far along the way; with nothing on 'to' it passes the sound through. Latency is 42.7 ms (2048 samples).
column2: 把声音变形为“to”引脚上的声音，方法是把其频谱峰值滑向另一个声音的位置，而不是交叉渐变，因此 440 Hz 的音通过 660 Hz 变成 880 Hz。Slide 设定走过多少路程；“to”上没有接入内容时，声音原样通过。延迟为 42.7 ms（2048 个采样）。

column1: Move Node
column2: 移动节点

column1: Move the playhead to the end of the last clip
column2: 将播放头移到最后一个剪辑的末尾

column1: Move the playhead to the start of the timeline
column2: 将播放头移到时间线的开头

column1: Move the selected clips one grid step; with nothing selected, step the playhead
column2: 将所选剪辑移动一个网格步长；无选择时，步进播放头

column1: Moves every spectral peak of the sound to the nearest note of a scale, so chords and layered sources stay in key. Snap blends between untouched and fully in tune, glide sets how fast a peak slides to its new note, and global key follows the transport's key and scale. Latency is 42.7 ms (2048 samples).
column2: 把声音的每个频谱峰值移到某音阶中最近的音，使和弦和叠加的来源保持在调内。Snap 在未触及和完全合调之间混合，glide 设定峰值滑向新音的速度，global key 跟随传输的调性和音阶。延迟为 42.7 ms（2048 个采样）。

column1: Moves, rotates and scales only the faces marked by an upstream Select op, optionally sliding them along their own normals instead of a fixed direction.
column2: 只移动、旋转和缩放上游 Select 操作标记的面，可选择沿其自身法线而不是固定方向滑动。

column1: Moves, rotates and scales the input mesh by a fixed offset - the geometry equivalent of the 2D Transform effect.
column2: 按固定偏移移动、旋转和缩放输入网格——相当于 2D Transform 效果的几何体版本。

column1: Multi-mode state-variable & ladder filter (LP12/24/36, HP, BP, Notch, Peak) with drive and resonance control.
column2: 多模式状态变量与梯形滤波器（LP12/24/36、HP、BP、Notch、Peak），带驱动和共振控制。

column1: Multi-voice polyphonic wavetable oscillator (up to 8 voices) with two independent A/B wavetable engines crossfaded against each other, wavetable position morphing, detuned unison, and integrated stereo spread.
column2: 多声部复音波表振荡器（最多 8 个声部），带两个独立的 A/B 波表引擎并可相互交叉渐变，具备波表位置变形、失谐齐奏和内置立体声展宽。

column1: Multiplies brightness by powers of two, like a camera's exposure stop (compare Levels' linear/gamma remap).
column2: 把亮度乘以 2 的幂，就像相机的曝光档（对比 Levels 的线性/gamma 重映射）。

column1: Multiplies the input by an oscillator (freq, waveform) - true ring modulation, not amplitude modulation, so the original frequencies are replaced by sum/difference sidebands rather than just scaled.
column2: 将输入与振荡器（freq、waveform）相乘——真正的环形调制，而不是调幅，因此原有频率被和/差边带取代，而不是仅仅被缩放。

column1: Mute the selected clips (they draw hatched) or bring them back
column2: 将所选剪辑静音（以斜线填充显示）或恢复

column2: 下一个节点

column2: 此节点没有其他说明。

column2: 节点帮助

column1: Non-linear transfer curve distortion, saturation drive, bias, and anti-aliased oversampled waveshaping.
column2: 非线性传递曲线失真、饱和驱动、偏置，以及抗混叠过采样波形整形。

column1: Note gate length shaping, timing/velocity jitter humanization, and portamento glide.
column2: 音符门控长度整形、时间/力度抖动的人性化，以及滑音 glide。

column1: Note on the canvas
column2: 关于画布的说明

column1: Nothing enforces that order - any output can feed any input, including back into effects for feedback-style chains.
column2: 没有什么强制这种顺序——任何输出都可以接入任何输入，包括回到效果中构成反馈式链路。

column1: Now every frame is the previous frame, nudged, with the source drawn over the top - which gives you infinite-zoom tunnels, echoes and growth. Set the Blend to Screen or Lighten and lower the opacity so the history fades rather than saturating.
column2: 现在每一帧都是上一帧稍作位移，再把来源绘制在上面——由此得到无限缩放的隧道、回声和生长效果。把 Blend 设为 Screen 或 Lighten 并降低不透明度，让历史逐渐淡出而不是饱和。

column1: Nudge Clips / Step Playhead
column2: 微移剪辑 / 步进播放头

column1: Nudge Param
column2: 微调参数

column1: Offsets a blurred copy of the image's alpha behind it as a shadow, in a chosen Colour, Offset X/Y and Opacity.
column2: 把图像 Alpha 的模糊副本偏移到图像后面作为阴影，可选 Colour、Offset X/Y 和 Opacity。

column1: Offsets each pixel using a second patched-in image's red/green channels as a displacement map, or a built-in animated wave if nothing is patched. Map Scale tiles the map.
column2: 用接入的第二张图像的红/绿通道作为位移贴图来偏移每个像素；若未接入任何内容，则使用内置的动画波浪。Map Scale 使贴图平铺。

column1: On-device segmentation via Apple Vision - no model download, no network, no key. Subject mode (any salient foreground) needs macOS 14, Person mode macOS 12; the node says so when the OS is too old. Segmentation is expensive, so the mask is computed on this interval rather than every frame.
column2: 通过 Apple Vision 在设备上进行分割——无需下载模型、无需网络、无需密钥。Subject 模式（任何显著前景）需要 macOS 14，Person 模式需要 macOS 12；系统过旧时节点会提示。分割开销很大，因此遮罩按此间隔计算，而不是每一帧都计算。

column1: On-device segmentation via the OS - no model download, no network, no key. Subject mode needs macOS 14, Person mode macOS 12. Segmentation is expensive, so the mask is computed on this interval rather than every frame; for video, raise the interval or use auto-refresh.
column2: 通过操作系统在设备上进行分割——无需下载模型、无需网络、无需密钥。Subject 模式需要 macOS 14，Person 模式需要 macOS 12。分割开销很大，因此遮罩按此间隔计算，而不是每一帧都计算；处理视频时请调大间隔或使用 auto-refresh。

column1: On-device segmentation with no network access and no API key: Windows has no Vision equivalent, so a small model (u2netp) ships with the build and runs through ONNX Runtime on the DirectML GPU provider, falling back to CPU when DirectML does not register - the node's header line says which. Both Subject and Person modes use the same model. Segmentation is expensive, so the mask is computed on this interval rather than every frame.
column2: 在设备上分割，无需网络访问也无需 API 密钥：Windows 没有 Vision 的等价物，因此随构建附带一个小模型（u2netp），通过 ONNX Runtime 在 DirectML GPU 提供程序上运行，DirectML 未能注册时回退到 CPU——节点的标题行会说明用的是哪个。Subject 和 Person 模式使用同一个模型。分割开销很大，因此遮罩按此间隔计算，而不是每一帧都计算。

column1: On-device segmentation with no network access and no API key: a small model (u2netp) ships with the build and runs through ONNX Runtime on the CPU provider. Both Subject and Person modes use the same model. Segmentation is expensive, and CPU inference more so, so raise the interval for video rather than computing a mask every frame.
column2: 在设备上分割，无需网络访问也无需 API 密钥：随构建附带一个小模型（u2netp），通过 ONNX Runtime 在 CPU 提供程序上运行。Subject 和 Person 模式使用同一个模型。分割开销很大，CPU 推理更甚，因此处理视频时请调大间隔，而不是每一帧都计算遮罩。

column1: One filter, one of 12 types (LP/HP at 12/24/36 dB, BP, notch, shelves, peak, all-pass). Drag the handle on the response curve to set frequency and gain, Shift-drag to set Q - the picture is the control.
column2: 一个滤波器，12 种类型之一（12/24/36 dB 的 LP/HP、BP、陷波、架式、峰值、全通）。拖动响应曲线上的手柄设置频率和增益，Shift+拖动设置 Q——图形本身就是控制。

column1: One short modulated delay line with feedback - the jet-swoosh comb filter. Feedback past zero flips the comb's polarity for a hollower sound; the right channel reads a quarter-cycle ahead of the left for width.
column2: 一条带反馈的短调制延迟线——喷气式“嗖嗖”梳状滤波器。反馈越过零会翻转梳状的极性，声音更空洞；右声道比左声道提前四分之一周期读取，以增加宽度。

column1: Open Patch
column2: 打开补丁

column1: Open an existing .inf patch file
column2: 打开已有的 .inf 补丁文件

column1: Open appearance, canvas, audio, and performance settings
column2: 打开外观、画布、音频和性能设置

column1: Open quick type-to-filter node picker
column2: 打开可输入筛选的快速节点选择器

column1: Or drag empty track space to draw a clip, then assign a source node to it from the inspector.
column2: 或在空轨道上拖动绘制片段，然后在检查器中为其指定源节点。

column1: Output shows the result, exports a PNG, or records a video.
column2: Output 用于显示结果、导出 PNG 或录制视频。

column1: Outputs 1 when the comparison holds, 0 otherwise - >, >=, <, <=, ==, != between two modulators, with a tolerance for the equality checks.
column2: 比较成立时输出 1，否则输出 0——在两个调制器之间比较 >、>=、<、<=、==、!=，相等判断带有容差。

column1: Outputs 1 when the comparison holds, 0 otherwise.
column2: 比较成立时输出 1，否则输出 0。

column1: Outputs a moving 3D point (X/Y/Z, each patchable separately) travelling around a built-in shape (circle, helix, spiral, lissajous, etc.) at a beat-synced speed, or along the points of a patched-in geometry/curve source instead.
column2: 输出一个移动的 3D 点（X/Y/Z 可分别接线），按与节拍同步的速度沿内置形状（圆、螺旋线、螺线、利萨如图形等）运动，或改为沿接入的几何体/曲线源的点运动。

column1: Outputs one fixed number - the simplest possible modulator, useful for feeding a Math input or a modulation slot that expects a cable rather than manual control.
column2: 输出一个固定数值——最简单的调制器，适合为 Math 输入或需要连线而非手动控制的调制槽提供数值。

column1: Outputs the previous frame - a one-frame delay, not an effect. It only does something visible inside a loop: patch a downstream node's output back into a Feedback node's input, then use that Feedback output upstream, without the graph recursing. See Menu > Help > 'Using Feedback' for the full patch.
column2: 输出上一帧——一帧延迟，而不是效果。只有在循环中才会产生可见作用：把下游节点的输出接回 Feedback 节点的输入，再把该 Feedback 的输出接到上游，图就不会递归。完整补丁见 Menu > Help > 'Using Feedback'。

column1: Outputs the previous frame. Nothing visible on its own - it is the delay that makes a loop legal. See 'Using Feedback' above.
column2: 输出上一帧。本身没有可见效果——它是让循环合法的那一帧延迟。参见上文 'Using Feedback'。

column1: Overrides how long a note sounds: holdMs schedules the note-off that many ms after note-on instead of passing the real one through, for a fixed duration regardless of how long the key was held. 0 = passthrough (off).
column2: 覆盖音符的持续时间：holdMs 会在音符开始后经过该毫秒数时安排音符结束，而不是传递真实的音符结束，因此无论按键按了多久，时长都固定。0 = 直通（关闭）。

column1: Paint straight onto the node preview. Six procedural brushes, eraser, spacing and jitter. Patch an image in to paint over it. Record, then draw - replaying redraws the stroke in time, and the canvas size follows the input when one is patched in.
column2: 直接在节点预览上绘画。六种程序化笔刷、橡皮擦、间距和抖动。接入图像即可在其上绘制。先录制再绘制——回放会按时间重绘笔触，接入输入时画布尺寸跟随输入。

column1: Paint straight onto the node preview. Six procedural brushes, eraser, spacing and jitter. Patch an image in to paint over it. Strokes can be recorded and replayed as an animation.
column2: 直接在节点预览上绘画。六种程序化笔刷、橡皮擦、间距和抖动。接入图像即可在其上绘制。笔触可录制并作为动画回放。

column1: Pan Canvas
column2: 平移画布

column1: Pan Canvas (keys)
column2: 平移画布（按键）

column1: Pan graph view
column2: 平移图视图

column1: Pan the canvas
column2: 平移画布

column1: Part of the 3D geometry/render pipeline - geometry and point-cloud nodes feed into Render 3D via a Camera and Lights.
column2: 3D 几何体/渲染管线的一部分——几何体和点云节点通过 Camera 和 Lights 送入 Render 3D。

column1: Part of the note chain - takes note events in on its 'notes' pin and passes them out, changed. Feed a synth (Wavetable, Sampler) from the end of the chain.
column2: 音符链的一部分——从其 'notes' 引脚接收音符事件，修改后再传出。从链末端接入合成器（Wavetable、Sampler）。

column1: Particle System is a 3D emitter with gravity, turbulence, collision planes and spring-mass dynamics. Cloth is a pinned mass-spring sheet with wind and collision.
column2: Particle System 是带重力、湍流、碰撞平面和弹簧质点动力学的 3D 发射器。Cloth 是带风力和碰撞的固定质点弹簧布料。

column1: Pass-through modulation node that accepts an incoming modulator and forwards it to its output. Useful for monitoring, signal routing, or placeholders.
column2: 直通调制节点，接收传入的调制器并转发到输出。可用于监视、信号路由或占位。

column1: Paste copied nodes with automatic offset
column2: 粘贴已复制的节点并自动偏移

column1: Per-channel spline curve editor - drag control points on Red/Green/Blue/Luminance, Photoshop Curves-style.
column2: 逐通道样条曲线编辑器——在 Red/Green/Blue/Luminance 上拖动控制点，类似 Photoshop 曲线。

column1: Physical modelling for struck and plucked metal - bells, gongs, bars, plates, chimes, tines, strings - via extended Karplus-Strong waveguides and inharmonic modal resonator banks.
column2: 敲击和拨奏金属的物理建模——钟、锣、条、板、风铃、音叉齿、弦——基于扩展 Karplus-Strong 波导和非谐波模态共振器组。

column1: Physics-based gravity bounce note generator (up to 12 balls, with speed, size, and range controls) creating organic rhythmic polyrhythms as balls hit walls.
column2: 基于物理的重力弹跳音符生成器（最多 12 个球，可调速度、大小和范围），球撞墙时产生有机的节奏复合律动。

column1: Pitch shifting, interval offset, pitch wheel modulation, and non-linear velocity mapping curves.
column2: 移调、音程偏移、弯音轮调制和非线性力度映射曲线。

column1: Play / Pause
column2: 播放 / 暂停

column1: Play / pause everything
column2: 播放 / 暂停全部

column1: Play button in the top bar
column2: 顶部栏中的播放按钮

column1: Playhead to End
column2: 播放头移至末尾

column1: Playhead to Start
column2: 播放头移至开头

column1: Plays a Standard MIDI File as a note source. Load a .mid (or drop one on the canvas) and it follows the transport: play, stop and seek move the playhead through the file, and the project tempo rules - the file's own tempo is ignored. transpose shifts every note, position (0 to 1 across the file) is where playback starts - it restarts from there whenever the transport starts or seeks, and jumps there when you move the knob. speed 1 follows the project bpm and scales it from there (the file's own tempo is ignored - it is just notes). vel scales every velocity, and loop repeats the file, rounded up to a whole 4/4 bar. Drum-channel (10) notes are never transposed. Format 0/1/2, SMPTE-timed (mapped at 2 beats per second) and RMID-wrapped files load; pitch bend and CCs are not played.
column2: 将标准 MIDI 文件作为音符源播放。加载 .mid（或将其拖到画布上），它会跟随传输：播放、停止和定位会在文件中移动播放头，并以项目速度为准——忽略文件自身的速度。transpose 移调所有音符，position（整个文件范围 0 到 1）是播放起点——每当传输开始或定位时都会从此处重新开始，拖动旋钮时也会跳到此处。speed 为 1 时跟随项目 bpm，并在此基础上缩放（文件自身的速度被忽略——它只是音符）。vel 缩放所有力度，loop 重复该文件，长度向上取整为完整的 4/4 小节。鼓通道（10）的音符不会被移调。支持 Format 0/1/2、SMPTE 计时（按每秒 2 拍映射）和 RMID 封装的文件；弯音和 CC 不会播放。

column1: Plays a fast chromatic run between a note and the next one as an approximation of portamento (NoteEvent has no continuous pitch, so this is a glissando, not a true pitch ramp).
column2: 在一个音符与下一个音符之间播放快速半音阶跑动，近似滑音（NoteEvent 没有连续音高，所以这是一种 glissando，而非真正的音高渐变）。

column1: Plays a video file. Position follows the transport, so it pauses with everything else. Loop and speed (including reverse) are available. Also outputs the clip's own audio track, if it has one, on the same transport-driven clock as the picture (audioEnabled/volume).
column2: 播放视频文件。位置跟随传输，因此会与其他内容一起暂停。支持循环和速度（含倒放）。若片段带有音轨，也会输出，并与画面使用同一个由传输驱动的时钟（audioEnabled/volume）。

column1: Plays the supported images in one folder in alphabetical order. Hold and transition time follow the global transport; Native Size keeps source pixels 1:1, Best Fit stretches to fill, and Proportional Fit preserves aspect.
column2: 按字母顺序播放一个文件夹中的受支持图像。停留和过渡时间跟随全局传输；Native Size 保持源像素 1:1，Best Fit 拉伸填满，Proportional Fit 保持宽高比。

column1: Plots any Field kernel's output as a curve or surface, so you can see what a kernel does before patching it into Field Effect, Field Synth or FieldPixel.
column2: 将任意 Field kernel 的输出绘制为曲线或曲面，方便你在接入 Field Effect、Field Synth 或 FieldPixel 之前看清 kernel 的作用。

column1: Point cloud in, mesh out: one vertex per point, with no edges or faces. This is the bridge that lets a cloud (Particle System, a Distribute node, Image to Points) re-enter the mesh operators that only know how to walk a Mesh. 'alive only' skips dead particles.
column2: 输入点云，输出网格：每个点一个顶点，没有边和面。这是让点云（Particle System、Distribute 节点、Image to Points）重新进入只能处理 Mesh 的网格运算符的桥梁。'alive only' 会跳过已消亡的粒子。

column1: Polyphonic chord generator, harmony generator, and interval stacking.
column2: 复音和弦生成器、和声生成器及音程叠加。

column1: Positions are in bars and beats, never seconds, so the whole arrangement retimes with the top bar's BPM. Audio clips from a file can follow project tempo: switch Sync on in the inspector and the clip is time-stretched by tempo / sample BPM, live, as you change the tempo. Switch it off and the clip plays at its native speed instead.
column2: 位置以小节和拍为单位，而不是秒，因此整个编排会随顶部栏的 BPM 重新计时。来自文件的音频片段可以跟随项目速度：在检查器中打开 Sync，片段会按 速度 / 采样 BPM 实时拉伸，随速度变化而变化。关闭后片段则以原始速度播放。

column1: Predictive Notes learns a played phrase as a Markov model and plays on in that style. Predictive Quantize learns the actual spacing between your onsets and pulls future timing toward it - a groove template, not Quantizer's fixed grid. Predictive Velocity learns the shape of your own dynamic range and remaps future velocities onto it, instead of Velocity Curve's one fixed exponent.
column2: Predictive Notes 将演奏的乐句学习为马尔可夫模型，并以该风格继续演奏。Predictive Quantize 学习你的起音之间的实际间隔，并将之后的时值拉向它——这是一种律动模板，而不是 Quantizer 的固定网格。Predictive Velocity 学习你自己的力度范围形态，并将之后的力度重映射到其上，而不是 Velocity Curve 的单一固定指数。

column1: Press / and start typing. Double-click an existing note to edit it.
column2: 按 / 开始输入。双击已有音符进行编辑。

column1: Previous / Next Marker
column2: 上一个 / 下一个标记

column1: Procedural noise: value, fBm, ridged, Voronoi, Worley edges and white. Domain warping, octaves and colour mapping included.
column2: 程序化噪声：value、fBm、ridged、Voronoi、Worley edges 和 white。包含域扭曲、倍频和颜色映射。

column1: Processes audio: one cable in, one cable out. Audio input pins take exactly one cable each - use a Mixer to sum signals and a Splitter to fan one out. See Menu > Help > Module reference for the effect families.
column2: 处理音频：一根线进，一根线出。音频输入引脚每个只接一根连线——用 Mixer 叠加信号，用 Splitter 分出一路。效果系列参见 Menu > Help > Module reference。

column1: Produces a changing number over time, not an image. Patch its output onto the small dot beside any slider to drive that parameter.
column2: 产生随时间变化的数值，而不是图像。把它的输出接到任意滑块旁的小圆点上即可驱动该参数。

column1: Publishes the connected image as a named NDI video source on the local network (OBS, vMix, Resolume, NDI Studio Monitor). Video only, no audio. Needs the free NDI runtime from ndi.video; without it the node says so and everything else works. NDI(R) is a registered trademark of Vizrt NDI AB.
column2: 将接入的图像作为命名的 NDI 视频源发布到本地网络（OBS、vMix、Resolume、NDI Studio Monitor）。仅视频，无音频。需要 ndi.video 提供的免费 NDI 运行时；缺少时节点会提示，其他功能不受影响。NDI(R) 是 Vizrt NDI AB 的注册商标。

column1: Pulls pixels toward, or pushes them away from, a centre point. Amount above 1 punches outward, below 1 pinches inward.
column2: 将像素向中心点拉近或推远。Amount 大于 1 时向外挤出，小于 1 时向内收缩。

column1: Pushes each face outward from the mesh's centre along its own normal, by Amount, randomized per-face by Seed.
column2: 沿各自法线将每个面从网格中心向外推出，距离为 Amount，并按 Seed 对每个面随机化。

column1: Put a Fit node before a Blend or Layer Stack when your sources are different sizes.
column2: 当源的尺寸不同时，请在 Blend 或 Layer Stack 之前放一个 Fit 节点。

column1: Quantizer snaps incoming notes to a scale and mode (the standard modes through Chromatic). Chorder builds a chord from each single note it is given.
column2: Quantizer 将传入音符吸附到某个音阶和调式（从标准调式到 Chromatic）。Chorder 为收到的每个单音构建一个和弦。

column1: Quantizes a modulator to semitone steps over range low..high, shown as a large +/-N st readout. Still outputs 0..1 like any modulator - it just restricts where in 0..1 the value can land, so the span maps onto whole semitones. Scale/root snap to scale degrees instead of every semitone (chromatic = off); glide adds portamento between steps, passing through unquantized values in transit on purpose.
column2: 将调制器量化为 low..high 范围内的半音步进，以大号 +/-N st 读数显示。仍像任何调制器一样输出 0..1——只是限制数值在 0..1 中的落点，使该区间对应整数半音。Scale/root 改为吸附到音阶级数而非每个半音（chromatic = 关闭）；glide 在步进之间加入滑音，过渡中特意经过未量化的值。

column1: Quantizes every incoming note's pitch to the nearest degree of the chosen scale/root - nothing else about the note (timing, velocity) changes. A plain inline gate, distinct from Note Filter's range/chance gating.
column2: 将每个传入音符的音高量化到所选 scale/root 的最近音级——音符的其他方面（时值、力度）不变。一个简单的串联门，不同于 Note Filter 的范围/概率门控。

column1: Rasterizes the geometry / camera / light / material graph into an image, with shadow mapping, ambient occlusion and HDR environment reflections (patch an HDRI node into its env input to replace the procedural sky). Antialiasing steps down automatically at large output sizes to stay inside GPU limits.
column2: 将几何体/相机/灯光/材质图光栅化为图像，支持阴影贴图、环境光遮蔽和 HDR 环境反射（将 HDRI 节点接入其 env 输入可替换程序化天空）。输出尺寸较大时抗锯齿会自动降级，以保持在 GPU 限制之内。

column1: Rasterizes the geometry/camera/light/material graph into an image. Antialiasing is reduced automatically at large output sizes to stay within GPU limits. Scenes over ~2 million triangles get noticeably heavier to render. An HDRI node patched into the env input replaces the procedural sky gradient for background, reflections and ambient light.
column2: 将几何体/相机/灯光/材质图光栅化为图像。输出尺寸较大时抗锯齿会自动降低，以保持在 GPU 限制之内。超过约 200 万三角形的场景渲染会明显变重。接入 env 输入的 HDRI 节点会替换程序化天空渐变，用于背景、反射和环境光。

column1: Re-triangulates the mesh; Jitter randomizes how each face is split, for a more organic, less uniform look.
column2: 重新三角化网格；Jitter 随机化每个面的拆分方式，使外观更有机、更不规则。

column1: Reads note events from a connected MIDI input device and outputs them as a note cable - the entry point for playing a synth or sampler from an external keyboard/controller. Turn on mpe for an MPE controller (Seaboard, Osmose, Linnstrument): each held note follows its own pitch bend.
column2: 从已连接的 MIDI 输入设备读取音符事件，并作为音符线输出——用外接键盘/控制器演奏合成器或采样器的入口。使用 MPE 控制器（Seaboard、Osmose、Linnstrument）时打开 mpe：每个按住的音符跟随各自的弯音。

column1: Real-time bytebeat and mathematical expression synthesis evaluating user formulas with dynamic variables (t, x, y, inputs).
column2: 实时 bytebeat 与数学表达式合成，使用动态变量（t、x、y、输入）计算用户公式。

column1: Receives a video texture published by another Windows application over Spout, zero-copy on the GPU. Pick a publisher from the node's list.
column2: 通过 Spout 接收其他 Windows 应用发布的视频纹理，GPU 零拷贝。从节点的列表中选择发布者。

column1: Receives a video texture published by another macOS application over Syphon, zero-copy on the GPU. Pick a publisher from the node's list.
column2: 通过 Syphon 接收其他 macOS 应用发布的视频纹理，GPU 零拷贝。从节点的列表中选择发布者。

column1: Receives any NDI video source on the network as an image - pick it from the list, which rescans in the background. Video only, no audio. Needs the free NDI runtime from ndi.video. NDI(R) is a registered trademark of Vizrt NDI AB.
column2: 将网络上的任意 NDI 视频源作为图像接收——从列表中选择，列表会在后台重新扫描。仅视频，无音频。需要 ndi.video 提供的免费 NDI 运行时。NDI(R) 是 Vizrt NDI AB 的注册商标。

column1: Receives real-time video from another Windows application over Spout2 - Resolume, OBS, TouchDesigner, MadMapper, Unreal, Unity - as a zero-copy shared GPU texture. Pick a sender from the list; it rescans periodically, so a sender that starts after this node does will appear.
column2: 通过 Spout2 接收其他 Windows 应用的实时视频——Resolume、OBS、TouchDesigner、MadMapper、Unreal、Unity——作为 GPU 零拷贝共享纹理。从列表中选择发送方；列表会定期重新扫描，因此在本节点之后启动的发送方也会出现。

column1: Receives real-time video from another macOS application over Syphon - Resolume, OBS, TouchDesigner, MadMapper, Unreal, Unity - as a zero-copy shared GPU texture (IOSurface). Pick a server from the list; it rescans periodically, so a server that starts after this node does will appear.
column2: 通过 Syphon 接收其他 macOS 应用的实时视频——Resolume、OBS、TouchDesigner、MadMapper、Unreal、Unity——作为 GPU 零拷贝共享纹理（IOSurface）。从列表中选择服务器；列表会定期重新扫描，因此在本节点之后启动的服务器也会出现。

column1: Recolors any 0-1 grayscale input through user-authored stops, up to 32 of them, with linear or constant interpolation. Unlike Gradient Map, it has no shape of its own - the shape comes from upstream.
column2: 通过用户自定义的色标（最多 32 个）为任意 0-1 灰度输入重新着色，支持线性或常量插值。与 Gradient Map 不同，它自身没有形状——形状来自上游。

column1: Recolors using a second patched-in image as a 1D palette strip - this pixel's Luminance (or a chosen channel) indexes across it. Offset shifts the index, Mix blends with the original.
column2: 使用接入的第二张图像作为一维调色板条重新着色——像素的 Luminance（或所选通道）决定在其中的位置。Offset 平移索引，Mix 与原图混合。

column1: Recomputes vertex normals - 'flat shade' gives hard per-face edges instead of smooth shading, 'flip' inverts which way every face points.
column2: 重新计算顶点法线——'flat shade' 给出硬的逐面边缘而非平滑着色，'flip' 反转每个面的朝向。

column1: Records any modulator patched into its input and plays it back. Press Rec to capture (live input passes through while recording), press Rec again to stop and it starts looping straight away. speed is the playback rate - 2x plays the take twice as fast - and low/high map the take onto an output range. Takes are timed in beats, so they follow the tempo and pause with the transport (up to 64 beats), and they are saved with the patch. With nothing patched in, it records its own in knob, so you can perform a gesture by hand.
column2: 录制接入输入的任意调制器并回放。按 Rec 开始捕获（录制时实时输入直通），再按一次 Rec 停止并立即开始循环。speed 是回放速率——2x 表示以两倍速播放录音——low/high 将录音映射到输出范围。录音以拍计时，因此会跟随速度并随传输暂停（最长 64 拍），并随补丁保存。未接入任何输入时，它录制自己的 in 旋钮，因此可以手动演绎一个动作。

column1: Records any patched modulator - hit Rec, then it loops the take back with adjustable speed and low/high range.
column2: 录制任意接入的调制器——按下 Rec，然后循环回放，速度和 low/high 范围可调。

column1: Records the first `grain` fraction of each tempo-synced (or free-ms) cycle, then loops that captured slice for the rest of the cycle before recording fresh audio next cycle - a beat-repeat glitch effect.
column2: 录制每个与速度同步（或自由毫秒）周期中前 `grain` 比例的部分，然后在该周期的其余时间循环这段捕获的片段，下一周期再录制新音频——一种节拍重复故障效果。

column1: Redo last undone action
column2: 重做上一个被撤销的操作

column1: Reduces the image to a fixed number of tonal Levels per channel, producing flat colour bands.
column2: 将图像缩减为每通道固定数量的色调 Levels，产生平坦的色带。

column1: Remaps a modulator through a draggable transfer curve - an S-curve, staircase, or exponential response, all things a slider can't express.
column2: 通过可拖动的传递曲线重映射调制器——S 形曲线、阶梯或指数响应，这些都是滑块无法表达的。

column1: Remaps a modulator through a draggable transfer curve - click empty space to add a point, drag to move it, right-click to remove it (or right-click empty space to reset to a straight line). The gridline marks 0.5, where a bipolar binding's 'no modulation' point lives, and the moving dot shows where the input currently sits on the curve. mix blends between the raw input and the curved output, so 0 is a true bypass.
column2: 通过可拖动的传递曲线重映射调制器——点击空白处添加点，拖动移动点，右键删除点（或右键点击空白处重置为直线）。网格线标出 0.5，即双极绑定的“无调制”点所在，移动的圆点显示输入当前在曲线上的位置。mix 在原始输入与曲线输出之间混合，因此 0 为真正的旁通。

column1: Remaps luminance onto a two-colour gradient (Shadow to Highlight), Photoshop Gradient Map-style. Mix blends with the original colour.
column2: 将亮度重映射到双色渐变（Shadow 到 Highlight），类似 Photoshop 渐变映射。Mix 与原始颜色混合。

column1: Remaps luminance onto a two-colour gradient.
column2: 将亮度重映射到双色渐变。

column1: Remaps one modulator's input range onto a different output range - patch in a 0..1 LFO and remap it to -2..2, for example.
column2: 将一个调制器的输入范围重映射到不同的输出范围——例如把 0..1 的 LFO 重映射为 -2..2。

column1: Remaps one modulator's input range onto a different output range.
column2: 将一个调制器的输入范围重映射到不同的输出范围。

column1: Removes a chosen Key Colour (green/blue-screen style), matched in a brightness-independent colour space. Tolerance/Softness shape the edge, Spill Removal desaturates colour-cast fringes, 'show: Matte' previews the alpha instead of the keyed result.
column2: 移除选定的 Key Colour（绿幕/蓝幕式），在与亮度无关的色彩空间中匹配。Tolerance/Softness 塑造边缘，Spill Removal 对偏色边缘去饱和，'show: Matte' 预览 alpha 而非抠像结果。

column1: Rename selected track, group, clip, or multiple selected clips
column2: 重命名所选轨道、组、片段或多个所选片段

column1: Renders incoming audio as an image, so every image node in the app becomes an audio visualiser: Waveform draws the oscilloscope trace, Spectrum the FFT magnitude across a chosen window size. gain scales the drawn amplitude, smoothing damps it between frames. Distinct from Audio Analyze, which produces numbers for modulation - this produces pixels.
column2: 将传入音频渲染为图像，因此应用中每个图像节点都能成为音频可视化器：Waveform 绘制示波器轨迹，Spectrum 在所选窗口大小上绘制 FFT 幅度。gain 缩放绘制的幅度，smoothing 在帧间对其平滑。不同于 Audio Analyze（产生用于调制的数值），这里产生的是像素。

column1: Renders text using any font installed on the system, with size, colour, tracking, alignment and position.
column2: 使用系统中安装的任意字体渲染文本，可设置大小、颜色、字距、对齐和位置。

column1: Renders the image as a dot pattern like offset printing. Scale sets dot density, Angle rotates the dot grid, 'style: Colour' uses three angled CMY-style dot layers instead of one greyscale layer.
column2: 将图像渲染为类似胶印的网点图案。Scale 设置网点密度，Angle 旋转网点网格，'style: Colour' 使用三层成角度的 CMY 式网点，而非单层灰度。

column1: Repeats every incoming note event, delay ms apart, with velocity decaying and pitch shifting per repeat - a delay line for notes rather than audio. The original note always passes through first; the repeats are on top of it, not instead of it.
column2: 重复每个传入的音符事件，间隔 delay ms，每次重复力度衰减、音高偏移——是针对音符而非音频的延迟线。原始音符总是先通过；重复叠加在其上，而不是取代它。

column1: Replaces every wavecycle of the input with a clean geometric waveform (Sine, Square, Triangle) of the same period and peak amplitude. Timbre is rebuilt while pitch and rhythm survive. Latency is one wavecycle.
column2: 将输入的每个波形周期替换为同周期、同峰值幅度的干净几何波形（Sine、Square、Triangle）。音色被重建，音高和节奏得以保留。延迟为一个波形周期。

column1: Replaces solid faces with a wireframe tube running along each edge, at a chosen Thickness.
column2: 将实体面替换为沿每条边延伸的线框管，粗细由 Thickness 决定。

column1: Replaces the alpha channel outright with the luminance of a second patched-in image - hand-drawn mattes, a Shape, a Ramp, or another branch's 'show alpha' output. With nothing patched into the second input the image is forced fully opaque instead.
column2: 用接入的第二张图像的亮度直接替换 alpha 通道——手绘遮罩、Shape、Ramp，或另一分支的 'show alpha' 输出。第二个输入未接入时，图像会被强制设为完全不透明。

column1: Resamples an input to a chosen resolution. Fit letterboxes, Fill crops, Stretch ignores aspect, Native passes through. Offset X/Y slides the result in output pixels (+ right, + up). Use it to make differently-sized sources composite predictably.
column2: 将输入重采样到所选分辨率。Fit 加黑边，Fill 裁切，Stretch 忽略宽高比，Native 直通。Offset X/Y 以输出像素平移结果（+ 向右，+ 向上）。用它让不同尺寸的源合成结果可预期。

column1: Reshapes incoming note velocity through a response curve (soft/linear/hard, or a custom curve) - the note-chain equivalent of a keybed velocity curve setting.
column2: 通过响应曲线（soft/linear/hard 或自定义曲线）重塑传入音符的力度——相当于音符链中的键盘力度曲线设置。

column1: Right-click a track or group header to render or export just that track or group; the full patch export is still in the top bar.
column2: 右键点击轨道或组标题，可仅渲染或导出该轨道或组；完整补丁导出仍在顶部栏。

column1: Right-click or double-click the canvas, then type to filter - or press Shift+N anywhere (Shift+N again closes it)
column2: 右键或双击画布，然后输入进行筛选——或在任意位置按 Shift+N（再按 Shift+N 关闭）

column1: Rings the vibration modes of a geometry input.
column2: 使几何体输入的振动模态发声。

column1: Rings the vibration modes of the shape on the 'shape' pin, like striking that object. Tune sets the lowest mode's pitch; the other modes follow from the shape's geometry, so a flat plate sounds bell-like and a long bar nearly harmonic. Pos is where it is struck and heard from: a mode stays silent when struck on its node line. With no shape connected it rings a flat rectangular plate.
column2: 使 'shape' 引脚上形状的振动模态发声，如同敲击该物体。Tune 设置最低模态的音高；其他模态由形状的几何决定，因此平板听起来像钟，长条几乎是谐波的。Pos 是敲击和拾音的位置：在节线上敲击时该模态保持静默。未连接形状时，它使一块平坦的矩形板发声。

column1: Rotates pixels increasingly the closer they are to a centre point, like a whirlpool. Angle is the twist amount, Radius how far it reaches.
column2: 越靠近中心点，像素旋转越多，如同漩涡。Angle 是扭转量，Radius 是作用范围。

column1: Rubber-band Select
column2: 框选

column1: Rubber-band select
column2: 框选

column1: Runs a Field kernel once per audio sample, on the audio thread - write your own sample-domain audio effect. `in` is the audio input pin, `state` declares per-voice memory, `param` exposes a modulatable knob. `reduce.rms(in, loHz, hiHz)` publishes a band-limited RMS meter reading once per block.
column2: 在音频线程上对每个音频采样运行一次 Field kernel——编写你自己的采样域音频效果。`in` 是音频输入引脚，`state` 声明每个声部的记忆，`param` 提供可调制旋钮。`reduce.rms(in, loHz, hiHz)` 每个块发布一次带限 RMS 电平读数。

column1: Runs a Field kernel once per output pixel, on the GPU - write your own image generator or effect in Field instead of GLSL. `state` declares persistent per-pixel memory that survives to the next frame (which is what makes reaction-diffusion and trail effects expressible here), `param` exposes a modulatable knob, and extra input/output image pins can be declared by the kernel. width/height set the output resolution; presets are complete starting kernels.
column2: 在 GPU 上对每个输出像素运行一次 Field kernel——用 Field 而非 GLSL 编写你自己的图像生成器或效果。`state` 声明可延续到下一帧的逐像素持久记忆（这使得反应扩散和拖尾效果得以实现），`param` 提供可调制旋钮，kernel 还可以声明额外的输入/输出图像引脚。width/height 设置输出分辨率；预设是完整的起始 kernel。

column1: Runs a Field kernel once, at edit time, to build part of the graph itself - emit("Type Name", k0, k1, ...) spawns a node and hands back a handle, connect()/set()/place() wire it up, set its params and position it. Press Regenerate to re-run: it diffs against what it built last time (by emit-site identity) instead of deleting and respawning, so hand-edits to params on the spawned nodes survive an unrelated Regenerate.
column2: 在编辑时运行一次 Field kernel，用来构建图本身的一部分——emit("Type Name", k0, k1, ...) 生成一个节点并返回句柄，connect()/set()/place() 用于连线、设置参数和定位。按 Regenerate 重新运行：它会与上次构建的内容（按 emit 位置标识）做差异比较，而不是删除再重新生成，因此对所生成节点参数的手动修改在无关的 Regenerate 后依然保留。

column1: Runs a per-vertex Field kernel over geometry, modifying P, N, uv, Cd and custom attributes with rate-inferred execution.
column2: 对几何体运行逐顶点 Field kernel，修改 P、N、uv、Cd 和自定义属性，执行速率由推断得出。

column1: Sample-rate reduction (rate, zero-order hold) and bit-depth quantization (bits) - the two classic lo-fi digital degradations, independent of each other.
column2: 采样率降低（rate，零阶保持）和位深量化（bits）——两种经典的低保真数字劣化，彼此独立。

column1: Samples colours from a reference image, loaded here or patched in - a patched cable overrides the loaded file, but the file is kept so unplugging falls back to it. Drag its 'out' onto the square dot beside any colour swatch to bind it - each new cable takes the next swatch, and clicking a bound swatch steps it. Its image output is a gradient of the palette.
column2: 从参考图像中采样颜色，图像可在此加载或接入——接入的连线会覆盖已加载的文件，但文件会保留，拔掉连线后回退到它。将其 'out' 拖到任意色块旁的方形圆点上进行绑定——每根新连线占用下一个色块，点击已绑定的色块可切换。其图像输出是调色板的渐变。

column1: Samples each face's centre point of the input mesh as a point cloud, for feeding Instance on Points or Metaballs.
column2: 将输入网格每个面的中心点采样为点云，用于送入 Instance on Points 或 Metaballs。

column1: Samples points along the input mesh's edges as a point cloud, for feeding Instance on Points or Metaballs.
column2: 沿输入网格的边采样点作为点云，用于送入 Instance on Points 或 Metaballs。

column1: Samples the input mesh's vertices as a point cloud, for feeding Instance on Points or Metaballs.
column2: 将输入网格的顶点采样为点云，用于送入 Instance on Points 或 Metaballs。

column1: Samples up to 16 points off a patched geometry source and outputs each as its own X/Y/Z modulator, plus a centroid (cx/cy/cz) and spread aggregate that stay meaningful however the row count or point set changes. Vertex mode reads native vertices (or a point cloud's points, which always wins over its own billboard mesh); Scatter reads an area-weighted random sample instead; Contour walks the mesh's boundary/slice outline (or a patched curve) in order. Sort turns the table into something specific - by axis for a ramp bank, by angle for a phase-ordered ring, by distance from the centre. offset scrubs a read head across the sampled set without re-sampling, so it's the one control worth binding to an LFO. Fixed space maps world units through `extent` (how far the object may travel, not how big it is); Bounds self-scales to the sampled set's own bounding box, which means a rigid translation of the source produces no change - that's by design, not a bug.
column2: 从接入的几何源采样最多 16 个点，把每个点输出为独立的 X/Y/Z 调制器，另加质心（cx/cy/cz）和 spread 汇总值，无论行数或点集如何变化都保持有意义。Vertex 模式读取原生顶点（或点云的点，点云的点始终优先于其自身的公告板网格）；Scatter 改为读取按面积加权的随机样本；Contour 按顺序遍历网格的边界/切片轮廓（或接入的曲线）。Sort 将表变成特定顺序——按轴排序用于斜坡组，按角度排序用于相位有序的环，按到中心的距离排序。offset 在已采样的集合上滑动读取头而无需重新采样，因此是最值得绑定到 LFO 的控件。Fixed space 通过 `extent` 映射世界单位（物体可移动多远，而不是它有多大）；Bounds 按采样集合自身的包围盒自适应缩放，这意味着源的刚性平移不会产生变化——这是设计如此，不是 bug。

column1: Save current patch
column2: 保存当前补丁

column1: Save patch to a new file
column2: 将补丁另存为新文件

column1: Scales how much of a modulator's swing reaches its destination, without having to know anything about the destination. Because a modulation binding overrides the knob outright, 'depth' collapses the signal toward 0.5 rather than adding a fraction on top: at 0 the destination sits at its own mid-range and the modulator has no say, at 1 the source passes through unchanged. Negative depth inverts, so one knob covers how much and which direction.
column2: 缩放调制器的摆幅有多少到达目标，而无需了解目标的任何信息。由于调制绑定会直接覆盖旋钮，'depth' 会把信号向 0.5 收拢，而不是在其上叠加一部分：为 0 时目标停在自身的中间值，调制器没有影响；为 1 时信号原样通过。负的 depth 会反相，因此一个旋钮同时控制幅度和方向。

column1: Scales the whole image's existing alpha by Opacity - a uniform fade that keeps the colour untouched. Unlike Color Overlay, nothing is tinted; unlike a Blend's opacity, the transparency is baked into the image and travels with it down the chain.
column2: 按 Opacity 缩放整幅图像现有的 alpha——统一的淡化，颜色保持不变。不同于 Color Overlay，不会着色；不同于 Blend 的不透明度，这里的透明度会烘焙进图像并随之沿链路传递。

column1: Scatters points across the input mesh's surface, area-weighted so large faces get proportionally more - even coverage, unlike Mesh to Points, which walks the vertex list and therefore clumps wherever the topology does (a UV Sphere's poles). Density sets how many; 'method' chooses plain Random or Poisson (blue-noise, honouring Min Distance so no two points crowd together).
column2: 在输入网格表面散布点，按面积加权，大面获得更多点——覆盖均匀，不同于 Mesh to Points（它遍历顶点列表，因此会在拓扑密集处聚集，例如 UV Sphere 的两极）。Density 设置数量；'method' 选择普通 Random 或 Poisson（蓝噪声，遵守 Min Distance，使任何两点都不会挤在一起）。

column1: Screens a blurred copy of the whole image back over itself, glowing everything rather than just bright spots (compare Bloom, which is threshold-based).
column2: 将整幅图像的模糊副本以滤色方式叠回自身，使一切发光，而不只是亮点（对比基于阈值的 Bloom）。

column1: Scroll (speed is adjustable in the Menu)
column2: 滚动（速度可在 Menu 中调整）

column1: Select all nodes on the canvas
column2: 选择画布上的所有节点

column1: Select multiple nodes in box
column2: 框选多个节点

column1: Select several
column2: 选择多个

column1: Select the neighbouring node in that direction
column2: 选择该方向上相邻的节点

column1: Select, then Delete, Backspace or Shift+X
column2: 选中后按 Delete、Backspace 或 Shift+X

column1: Sends its patched modulator input as an Open Sound Control message (address + float) to a host:port over UDP, on change (past an epsilon) or at least every interval - the one node in the patch with no output of its own.
column2: 将其接入的调制器输入作为 Open Sound Control 消息（地址 + 浮点数）通过 UDP 发送到 host:port，数值变化（超过 epsilon）时发送，或至少每隔 interval 发送一次——补丁中唯一没有自身输出的节点。

column1: Settings and the last graph layout are stored in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/Infinite (~/.config/Infinite by default).
column2: 设置和上次的图布局存储在 $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/Infinite（默认为 ~/.config/Infinite）。

column1: Settings and the last graph layout are stored in %%APPDATA%%\\Infinite.
column2: 设置和上次的图布局存储在 %%APPDATA%%\\Infinite。

column1: Settings and the last graph layout are stored in ~/Library/Application Support/Infinite.
column2: 设置和上次的图布局存储在 ~/Library/Application Support/Infinite。

column1: Shadow / midtone / highlight lift plus an S-curve control, per RGB channel or all together. Drag points on the curve to bend it, click empty curve to add a point, right-click a point to remove it.
column2: 阴影/中间调/高光提升加 S 曲线控制，可逐 RGB 通道或同时调整。拖动曲线上的点进行弯曲，点击曲线空白处添加点，右键点击点将其删除。

column1: Shape (or any source)  ->  Blend input A
column2: Shape (或任意源)  ->  Blend input A

column1: Shapes an incoming modulator with an ADSR contour, gated by it crossing threshold, instead of generating its own trigger.
column2: 用 ADSR 轮廓塑造传入的调制器，由其越过 threshold 来门控，而不是自己生成触发。

column1: Shift + drag
column2: Shift + 拖动

column1: Shift + drag a box around them, or Shift-click (or Ctrl-click) each one to add it. Then move, duplicate or delete as a group.
column2: 按住 Shift 拖出方框框住它们，或按住 Shift 点击（或 Ctrl 点击）逐个添加。然后可作为一组移动、复制或删除。

column1: Shift+H - the selected nodes, or every node when nothing is selected
column2: Shift+H - 所选节点，未选择任何节点时为所有节点

column1: Shift+J adds a video track, Shift+K an audio track (with the timeline focused).
column2: Shift+J 添加视频轨道，Shift+K 添加音频轨道（时间线获得焦点时）。

column1: Shift+K, same as the top bar's Start/Stop Audio
column2: Shift+K，与顶部栏的开始/停止音频相同

column1: Shift+M toggles the docked matrix of every active binding
column2: Shift+M 切换停靠的矩阵，显示所有活动绑定

column1: Shift+T opens a timeline docked beside the canvas. It does not replace the patch - it schedules it. A track ('lane') is video or audio, and every clip on it points at a node that already exists in your graph; the clip decides WHEN that node is heard or seen, not what it does.
column2: Shift+T 在画布旁打开一个停靠的时间线。它不会取代补丁——而是对补丁进行调度。轨道（'lane'）是视频或音频，轨道上的每个片段都指向图中已存在的节点；片段决定该节点何时被听到或看到，而不是它做什么。

column1: Shift+T toggles the docked timeline. Once it has focus its own keys take over - see 'Arrangement timeline' below, or Menu > Help > Shortcuts for the full list.
column2: Shift+T 切换停靠的时间线。获得焦点后由它自己的按键接管——参见下文 'Arrangement timeline'，或 Menu > Help > Shortcuts 查看完整列表。

column1: Shift+V toggles panel (or docks/undocks selected nodes)
column2: Shift+V 切换面板（或停靠/取消停靠所选节点）

column1: Shifts every incoming note's pitch by a fixed number of semitones.
column2: 将每个传入音符的音高移动固定的半音数。

column1: Shortcut
column2: 快捷键

column1: Show / hide parameter knobs & sliders
column2: 显示 / 隐藏参数旋钮和滑块

column1: Show the help for the selected node
column2: 显示所选节点的帮助

column1: Shows its input at actual pixel size in its own resizable window, separate from the small node preview - useful for judging detail without zooming the whole canvas.
column2: 在其自己的可调整大小的窗口中以实际像素尺寸显示输入，独立于小的节点预览——无需缩放整个画布即可判断细节。

column1: Shows the alpha channel as a greyscale image, fully opaque - white is solid, black is transparent. A viewer, not an edit: it replaces the colour so you can see the matte a key produced, and is usually the first thing to reach for when a composite is going wrong.
column2: 将 alpha 通道显示为灰度图像，完全不透明——白色为实心，黑色为透明。这只是查看器，不是编辑：它替换颜色，让你看到抠像生成的遮罩，合成出问题时通常最先该用它。

column1: Signed-distance geometry written as Field kernels and combined/warped by modifiers, then meshed - the procedural counterpart to the fixed primitives.
column2: 以 Field kernel 编写的有符号距离几何体，由修改器组合/扭曲，然后网格化——相对于固定基本体的程序化对应物。

column1: Simulates a camera lens: Barrel bows the image in or out, Chromatic separates the colour channels' distortion for fringing, Zoom scales the result.
column2: 模拟相机镜头：Barrel 使图像向内或向外弯曲，Chromatic 分离各颜色通道的畸变以产生色边，Zoom 缩放结果。

column1: Sine, triangle, saw up/down, square and sample-and-hold. Rate in beats, plus phase and an output range.
column2: 正弦、三角、锯齿上/下、方波和采样保持。速率以拍为单位，另有相位和输出范围。

column1: Single note input, same shape as Predictive Notes, but pitch is learned as an interval from a 'root' note rather than an absolute pitch. Root auto-detects to the most common learned note and is then a plain param - the pattern's relPitch is fixed by what was learned, but changing root after the fact transposes playback live without relearning, since resolution happens at play time against whatever root is currently selected.
column2: 单音符输入，形态与 Predictive Notes 相同，但音高学习为相对 'root' 音符的音程，而不是绝对音高。Root 自动检测为最常出现的已学习音符，之后就是普通参数——模式的 relPitch 由所学内容固定，但事后更改 root 会实时移调回放而无需重新学习，因为解析发生在播放时，针对当前选择的 root。

column1: Single-cycle waveform distortion and crossfade shaper.
column2: 单周期波形失真和交叉淡化塑形器。

column1: Six glitch algorithms behind one 'kind' dropdown: Slice Shift (blocky RGB-split rows), RGB Shift, Scanlines, Blocks (jittered tiles), Wave, and Datamosh (sliced/shuffled rows with colour smear). Amount/Detail control strength/scale, Speed animates it, Seed reseeds the randomness.
column2: 六种故障算法集于一个 'kind' 下拉菜单：Slice Shift（块状 RGB 分离行）、RGB Shift、Scanlines、Blocks（抖动方块）、Wave 和 Datamosh（切片/打乱的行加颜色拖影）。Amount/Detail 控制强度/尺度，Speed 使其动起来，Seed 重置随机性。

column1: Slices audio into overlapping grains, calculates per-grain metrics (Level, Brightness, Random), and rearranges them based on a continuous blend between original temporal position and metric rank. At amount 0 it is the clean identity passthrough; at 1 it is fully sorted into a swell or brightness contour. Rendering runs asynchronously on a worker thread.
column2: 将音频切成重叠的颗粒，计算每个颗粒的指标（Level、Brightness、Random），并根据原始时间位置与指标排名之间的连续混合对其重新排列。amount 为 0 时是干净的恒等直通；为 1 时完全按排序形成渐强或亮度轮廓。渲染在工作线程上异步运行。

column1: Slices the image into angular Segments around a centre and mirrors each one, kaleidoscope-style. Rotation spins the pattern, Zoom scales it.
column2: 围绕中心将图像切成角度 Segments 并镜像每一块，万花筒式。Rotation 旋转图案，Zoom 缩放。

column1: Smears the image along a straight line, like camera or subject motion. Angle sets the direction, Distance how far it smears.
column2: 沿直线拖影图像，如同相机或主体运动。Angle 设置方向，Distance 设置拖影距离。

column1: Snaps every spectral peak of the sound to the nearest note of a scale, polyphonically.
column2: 将声音的每个频谱峰值复音地吸附到音阶中最近的音。

column1: Snaps incoming note-on timing forward to the nearest grid line, at a chosen note division.
column2: 将传入音符的起音时间向前吸附到最近的网格线，按所选音符分段。

column1: Source (image, video, shape, noise, formula) makes a picture.
column2: Source（图像、视频、形状、噪声、公式）生成画面。

column1: Split at Playhead
column2: 在播放头处分割

column1: Splits incoming audio into up to 8 frequency bands - drag the dividers right on the spectrum display to resize them - and assigns each one a colour, VIBGYOR by default from low to high. With no image patched in it outputs the resulting gradient standalone; patch one into its optional image input and it grades that image by luminance through the same audio-reactive palette instead.
column2: 将传入音频分成最多 8 个频段——直接在频谱显示上拖动分隔线调整大小——并为每个频段指定颜色，默认由低到高为 VIBGYOR。未接入图像时，单独输出生成的渐变；将图像接入其可选的图像输入，则会通过同一个音频响应调色板按亮度为该图像调色。

column1: Spreads the notes of a chord across time instead of firing them together - strumMs per voice, in ascending pitch order, with each note's original gate length preserved. One knob: at 0 it is a passthrough, and the further up it goes the more the chord reads as strummed rather than struck.
column2: 将和弦的音符在时间上展开，而不是同时触发——每个声部间隔 strumMs，按音高升序，并保留每个音符原有的门长。只有一个旋钮：为 0 时直通，调得越高，和弦听起来越像扫弦而非齐奏。

column1: Stamps a shape at every point of a point source, drawn in one instanced call. Input A is the points source (Faces/Edges/Points sampler, a point cloud, etc.), input B is the shape to stamp at each point - both are required before it draws anything. Any node chained after this one operates on the shape being stamped, once, not on the realized scatter - except Transform, which is the exception that moves the whole scatter as one rigid group.
column2: 在点源的每个点上盖印一个形状，通过一次实例化调用绘制。Input A 是点源（Faces/Edges/Points 采样器、点云等），Input B 是在每个点上盖印的形状——两者都必须接入才会绘制。此节点之后串联的任何节点作用于被盖印的形状（一次），而不是实际散布的结果——Transform 除外，它会把整个散布作为一个刚体组整体移动。

column1: Start / pause timeline and animations
column2: 开始 / 暂停时间线和动画

column1: Start / stop audio device. Canvas only - with the timeline focused, Shift+K adds an audio track instead
column2: 启动 / 停止音频设备。仅限画布——时间线获得焦点时，Shift+K 改为添加音频轨道

column1: Steps through a folder of images on a beat interval, with an optional crossfade.
column2: 按节拍间隔逐个切换文件夹中的图像，可选交叉淡化。

column1: Streaming phase vocoder (N=2048, hop 512) that smears spectral magnitude in time. Transients dissolve into a harmonic cloud with tilt, phase diffusion and freeze. Latency is 42.7 ms (2048 samples); default mix is pinned at 1.0.
column2: 流式相位声码器（N=2048，hop 512），在时间上涂抹频谱幅度。瞬态溶解为带倾斜、相位扩散和冻结的谐波云。延迟为 42.7 ms（2048 个采样）；默认 mix 固定为 1.0。

column1: Subdivision surface. Each level roughly quadruples the triangle count, so higher levels get expensive fast; Smooth controls how much it rounds corners.
column2: 细分曲面。每一级大约使三角形数量变为四倍，因此较高级别很快变得昂贵；Smooth 控制转角被圆化的程度。

column1: Swaps transparent for solid and back (alpha = 1 - alpha), leaving the colour alone - the 'invert matte' switch a key would otherwise need a second node to get.
column2: 将透明变为实心，反之亦然（alpha = 1 - alpha），颜色不变——抠像本来需要第二个节点才能实现的“反转遮罩”开关。

column1: Sweeps the input profile around an Axis in a helical path - Steps sets resolution, Turns the number of revolutions, Rise/turn the pitch, Radius offsets the sweep outward.
column2: 使输入轮廓围绕 Axis 沿螺旋路径扫掠——Steps 设置分辨率，Turns 为圈数，Rise/turn 为螺距，Radius 使扫掠向外偏移。

column1: Symmetry (mirror about X, Y or both), Kaleidoscope (segment count, rotation, zoom) and Mirror Tile.
column2: Symmetry（沿 X、Y 或两者镜像）、Kaleidoscope（分段数、旋转、缩放）和 Mirror Tile。

column1: Syphon/Spout texture sharing is not available on Linux, so this node has no sender to receive from and outputs a placeholder. Use Video In (V4L2) or a file source instead.
column2: Linux 上不支持 Syphon/Spout 纹理共享，因此此节点没有可接收的发送方，输出占位图。请改用 Video In (V4L2) 或文件源。

column1: Syphon/Spout texture sharing is not available on Linux, so this node has no sources to receive from.
column2: Linux 上不支持 Syphon/Spout 纹理共享，因此此节点没有可接收的来源。

column1: Syphon/Spout texture sharing is not available on Linux.
column2: Linux 上不支持 Syphon/Spout 纹理共享。

column1: Tempo-synced arpeggiation patterns (Up, Down, Up/Down, Random, Chord, As-Played), octave span, and gate length.
column2: 与速度同步的琶音模式（Up、Down、Up/Down、Random、Chord、As-Played）、八度跨度和门长。

column1: Tempo-synced ping-pong / stereo bounce delay, feedback filters, high-density Feedback Delay Network (FDN) reverberator with predelay and damping.
column2: 与速度同步的乒乓/立体声弹跳延迟、反馈滤波器、带预延迟和阻尼的高密度反馈延迟网络（FDN）混响器。

column1: Terminal node. Shows the final image, exports a PNG, and records an H.264 .mov at a chosen frame rate. Recording captures the cooked output, so what you see is what is written.
column2: 终端节点。显示最终图像、导出 PNG，并以所选帧率录制 H.264 .mov。录制捕获的是已计算的输出，所见即所写。

column1: The Levels remap applied to the alpha channel only: Low/High clamp and normalise the matte's range (choking a soft edge tighter or spreading it wider) and Gamma bends the falloff between them. The go-to cleanup pass after Chroma Key or Alpha from Luma.
column2: 仅应用于 alpha 通道的 Levels 重映射：Low/High 对遮罩范围进行限幅和归一化（使柔边收紧或展宽），Gamma 弯曲两者之间的衰减。在 Chroma Key 或 Alpha from Luma 之后的首选清理步骤。

column1: The audio routing family. Audio Out is the terminal node. Every audio input pin takes exactly one cable, so Mixer is the only node that sums (4-8 slots, each with gain/pan/mute/solo) and Splitter is the only fan-out point. Gain is a single dB stage with a meter; Blend Audio is an equal-power crossfade between two inputs.
column2: 音频路由系列。Audio Out 是终端节点。每个音频输入引脚只接一根连线，因此 Mixer 是唯一的叠加节点，Splitter 是唯一的分出点。Gain 是带电平表的单一 dB 级；Blend Audio 是两个输入之间的等功率交叉淡化。

column1: The base 2D vector-primitive node - pick any of its 20 shapes from the dropdown, with fill, stroke, feather and background controls. Each shape also has its own directly-spawnable named node (Circle, Hexagon, Star, ...) that just starts on that shape.
column2: 基础 2D 矢量基本体节点——可从下拉菜单选择其 20 种形状中的任意一种，带填充、描边、羽化和背景控件。每种形状也有各自可直接生成的命名节点（Circle、Hexagon、Star……），只是初始即为该形状。

column1: The base 3D primitive node - pick any of its 24 shapes from the dropdown. Each shape also has its own directly-spawnable named node (Cube, Sphere, Torus, ...) that just starts on that shape.
column2: 基础 3D 基本体节点——可从下拉菜单选择其 24 种形状中的任意一种。每种形状也有各自可直接生成的命名节点（Cube、Sphere、Torus……），只是初始即为该形状。

column1: The explicit fan-out point for audio: an ordinary audio output feeds exactly one destination, so sending one signal to several places needs this node. Its own output is the one exempt from that rule. On the audio thread it is a plain copy - it exists for the graph-level visibility and the fan-out cap, not because copying is otherwise needed.
column2: 音频的显式分出点：普通音频输出只能接一个目标，因此要把一路信号送到多处就需要此节点。它自己的输出不受该规则限制。在音频线程上它只是一次简单复制——它的存在是为了图层面的可见性和分出数量上限，而不是因为复制本身有必要。

column1: The mesh equivalent of Resynthesize: each generation applies a weighted mix of geometry operators to the previous one, drifting the shape over time. 'step' advances one generation manually, 'auto step' runs it continuously, 'randomise' re-rolls the seed.
column2: Resynthesize 的网格版本：每一代对上一代应用几何运算符的加权混合，使形状随时间漂移。'step' 手动前进一代，'auto step' 连续运行，'randomise' 重新抽取种子。

column1: The one family that edits an existing alpha channel rather than making a new one: Show Alpha (view the matte), Opacity, Set Alpha (take alpha from a second image's luminance), Alpha Invert, Alpha from Luma, Alpha Levels (choke or spread a soft edge) and Premultiply / Unpremultiply.
column2: 唯一编辑已有 alpha 通道而不是新建的系列：Show Alpha（查看遮罩）、Opacity、Set Alpha（从第二张图像的亮度取得 alpha）、Alpha Invert、Alpha from Luma、Alpha Levels（收紧或展宽柔边）以及 Premultiply / Unpremultiply。

column1: The only node that sums audio - every other audio input pin takes exactly one cable, so any time two signals have to meet, they meet here. Four to eight slots, each with its own gain, pan, mute and solo, summed to one output.
column2: 唯一叠加音频的节点——其他所有音频输入引脚只接一根连线，因此两路信号需要汇合时都在这里汇合。四到八个槽位，各有自己的增益、声像、静音和独奏，叠加为一路输出。

column1: The pad counterpart of MIDI CC: it fires a decaying 0..1 pulse whenever one specific MIDI note is hit, then sits at 0. A pad hit is an event rather than a position, so this spikes and decays over 'hold' seconds the way Audio Analyze's onset output does, instead of holding a live value. Velocity sensitivity scales the spike by how hard the pad was struck.
column2: MIDI CC 的打击垫对应版本：每当某个特定 MIDI 音符被敲击时，它触发一个衰减的 0..1 脉冲，然后保持为 0。打击垫的敲击是事件而非位置，因此它像 Audio Analyze 的 onset 输出一样，在 'hold' 秒内先尖峰后衰减，而不是保持一个实时数值。Velocity sensitivity 按敲击的力度缩放尖峰。

column1: The system's only note fan-in point: up to four note inputs merged into one output stream, in timestamp order. Each input's notes stay independent voices matched by voice id, not pitch - so two inputs playing the same note at the same time sound as two overlapping voices, not a collision.
column2: 系统唯一的音符汇合点：最多四个音符输入按时间戳顺序合并为一路输出流。每个输入的音符保持为独立声部，按声部 id 而非音高匹配——因此两个输入同时演奏同一个音会形成两个重叠的声部，而不是冲突。

column1: The system's only note fan-out point: one input, four distinct outputs. Round Robin cycles through them, Random picks one per note, Chain advances only when the pitch changes (a held note stays put), and Probability rolls each output independently - a note can end up on several outputs at once, or (rarely) none, in which case it falls back to output 1. A note's whole lifetime (on through off) always stays on the output(s) it started on.
column2: 系统唯一的音符分出点：一个输入，四个独立输出。Round Robin 依次循环，Random 每个音符随机选一个，Chain 仅在音高变化时前进（持续的音符保持不动），Probability 对每个输出独立掷骰——一个音符可能同时出现在多个输出上，或（极少）一个都没有，此时回退到输出 1。音符的整个生命周期（从开始到结束）始终留在它开始时的输出上。

column1: The terminal node for audio, the counterpart of Output for images: whatever is patched in is summed into the selected output device. It has no processing of its own and no output pin. Two cables into one Audio Out is refused on purpose - route them through a Mixer instead, which is the only node in the app that sums audio. With several Audio Outs, plugin delay is compensated between them so they land together; press live to opt this one out when you are playing through it and want the lowest delay.
column2: 音频的终端节点，对应图像的 Output：接入的内容会叠加到所选输出设备。它自身没有处理，也没有输出引脚。两根连线接入同一个 Audio Out 会被有意拒绝——请通过 Mixer 路由，它是应用中唯一叠加音频的节点。存在多个 Audio Out 时，插件延迟会在它们之间补偿，使其同时到达；当你正通过某一个演奏并希望延迟最低时，按下 live 可使其退出补偿。

column1: The top bar holds a global clock: Play/Pause, Rewind and BPM. Everything time-based reads from it - modulators, video playback and animated shaders - so pausing freezes the whole patch and changing the tempo retimes all of it at once.
column2: 顶部栏包含全局时钟：Play/Pause、Rewind 和 BPM。所有与时间相关的内容都读取它——调制器、视频播放和动画着色器——因此暂停会冻结整个补丁，改变速度会同时为所有内容重新计时。

column1: Three parallel bandpass resonators tuned to a vowel's formants (F1/F2/F3), morphed continuously A-E-I-O-U by the vowel knob - a vocal-tract-shaped filter for any input, not just voice.
column2: 三个并联带通共振器调谐到元音的共振峰（F1/F2/F3），由 vowel 旋钮在 A-E-I-O-U 之间连续渐变——一种声道形状的滤波器，适用于任何输入，而不仅是人声。

column1: Tiles the image and alternately mirrors each tile so the edges line up seamlessly, unlike a plain repeat. Tiles sets how many repeats.
column2: 平铺图像并交替镜像每个图块，使边缘无缝对齐，不同于普通重复。Tiles 设置重复次数。

column2: 提示

column2: 构建编排的步骤：

column1: Toggle Audio Engine
column2: 切换音频引擎

column1: Toggle Params
column2: 切换参数

column1: Toggle bypass (power off) on the selected nodes. Canvas only - with the timeline focused, B is the blade tool instead
column2: 切换所选节点的旁通（关闭电源）。仅限画布——时间线获得焦点时，B 改为刀片工具

column1: Toggle docked arrangement timeline
column2: 切换停靠的编排时间线

column1: Toggle docked modulation matrix
column2: 切换停靠的调制矩阵

column1: Toggle docked performance matrix
column2: 切换停靠的演奏矩阵

column1: Toggle the blade: click a clip to cut it (and its group) at the mouse; Esc turns it off (B bypasses nodes when the canvas has focus)
column2: 切换刀片：点击片段，在鼠标位置切开它（及其组）；Esc 关闭（画布获得焦点时，B 为旁通节点）

column1: Toggle viewport panel (or dock selected nodes)
column2: 切换视口面板（或停靠所选节点）

column1: Transform, Array, Subdivide, Solidify, Extrude, Wireframe, Triangulate, Normals, Explode, Twist, Smooth, Mirror and Screw - plus Select and the ops that act only on its marked faces (Delete / Transform / Extrude Selected), Join Geometry's booleans (Union, Intersect, Difference), Displacement, Wrap and Merge by Distance.
column2: Transform、Array、Subdivide、Solidify、Extrude、Wireframe、Triangulate、Normals、Explode、Twist、Smooth、Mirror 和 Screw——以及 Select 和仅作用于其标记面的操作（Delete / Transform / Extrude Selected）、Join Geometry 的布尔运算（Union、Intersect、Difference）、Displacement、Wrap 和 Merge by Distance。

column1: Transforms one image into another. Its parameters (and the shape of its name) describe what it changes; see Menu > Help > Module reference for the effect families.
column2: 将一幅图像变换为另一幅。其参数（以及名称的形态）描述了它所改变的内容；效果系列参见 Menu > Help > Module reference。

column1: Transforms the UV or 3D texture coordinates used by materials/textures downstream - translate, rotate and scale, independent of moving the geometry itself.
column2: 变换下游材质/纹理所使用的 UV 或 3D 纹理坐标——平移、旋转和缩放，独立于移动几何体本身。

column1: Transient- or grid-sliced sample playback: chops a loaded sample into up to 64 slices and maps them chromatically from MIDI note 36, with draggable slice markers, a per-slice attack/decay pair, and a crossthrough toggle that lets a slice run past its own boundary.
column2: 按瞬态或网格切片的采样回放：将加载的采样切成最多 64 片，并从 MIDI 音符 36 起按半音阶映射，带可拖动的切片标记、每片的 attack/decay 对，以及 crossthrough 开关，使切片可越过自己的边界继续播放。

column1: Translate, scale, rotate, flip horizontal and flip vertical.
column2: 平移、缩放、旋转、水平翻转和垂直翻转。

column1: Translates, scales, rotates, and flips (horizontal/vertical) the whole image. Scale X/Y let you stretch non-uniformly on top of the overall Scale. Crop X/Y symmetrically crop the source in from each axis before the rest of the transform is applied.
column2: 平移、缩放、旋转并翻转（水平/垂直）整幅图像。Scale X/Y 可在整体 Scale 之上进行非等比拉伸。Crop X/Y 在应用其余变换之前，沿各轴对称地裁切源图像。

column1: Transport & Audio
column2: 传输与音频

column1: Transport and modulation
column2: 传输与调制

column1: Tuned bank of up to 16 parallel bandpass resonators excited by incoming audio. Four harmonic/tuning structures (Harmonic, Odd, Chord, Metallic) with decay (T60), scatter detune and stereo spread.
column2: 最多 16 个并联带通共振器的调谐组，由传入音频激励。四种谐波/调谐结构（Harmonic、Odd、Chord、Metallic），带衰减（T60）、散布失谐和立体声展宽。

column1: Turns an image or video into control values and modulation channels. Supports UV point probes, ROI boxes, 22 math/color operations, custom algebraic formulas, and multiple modulation output taps.
column2: 将图像或视频转换为控制值和调制通道。支持 UV 点探针、ROI 框、22 种数学/颜色运算、自定义代数公式以及多个调制输出抽头。

column1: Turns audio into a 3D mesh in the most literal way available: the waveform extruded as a flat ribbon through space, Segments points wide, with width/height scale and its own transform. Smoothing damps the trace between frames so it reads as a surface rather than a flicker. Takes audio on its own pin - it is a geometry source, so it goes into Render 3D, not into Audio Out.
column2: 以最字面的方式把音频变成 3D 网格：把波形挤出为穿过空间的平带，宽度为 Segments 个点，带有宽/高缩放和自己的变换。Smoothing 在帧间平滑轨迹，使其呈现为曲面而非闪烁。它在自己的引脚上接收音频——它是几何源，因此接入 Render 3D，而不是 Audio Out。

column1: Turns edges into a relief/bump look by differencing the image against itself offset along Angle/Distance. 'style: Over colour' keeps the original colours and adds the emboss on top; 'Grey' replaces the image with a flat emboss.
column2: 通过将图像与沿 Angle/Distance 偏移的自身做差，把边缘变成浮雕/凹凸效果。'style: Over colour' 保留原始颜色并在其上叠加浮雕；'Grey' 用平坦的浮雕取代图像。

column1: Turns live audio into an image - scrolling spectrogram, waveform or level field - so any image effect downstream becomes an audio visualiser.
column2: 将实时音频变成图像——滚动频谱图、波形或电平场——使下游任何图像效果都成为音频可视化器。

column1: Turns note velocity into a 0..1 modulator with an adjustable velocity range.
column2: 将音符力度转换为 0..1 调制器，力度范围可调。

column1: Twenty vector primitives - circle, ellipse, rectangle, rounded rect, triangle, polygon, star, ring, cross, line, hexagon, heart, arrow, crescent, gear, superellipse, pie, teardrop, chevron and blob - with fill, stroke, feather and background. Each one is also directly spawnable as its own named node.
column2: 二十种矢量基本体——circle、ellipse、rectangle、rounded rect、triangle、polygon、star、ring、cross、line、hexagon、heart、arrow、crescent、gear、superellipse、pie、teardrop、chevron 和 blob——带填充、描边、羽化和背景。每种也可直接生成为各自的命名节点。

column1: Twirl, pinch/punch, ripple, lens distortion (with chromatic aberration), displace and liquify. Position-dependent effects have Centre X/Y.
column2: Twirl、pinch/punch、ripple、镜头畸变（含色差）、displace 和 liquify。依赖位置的效果带有 Centre X/Y。

column1: Twists the mesh around a chosen Axis by Angle - the further a point is along that axis, the more it rotates.
column2: 沿所选 Axis 按 Angle 扭转网格——点沿该轴越远，旋转越多。

column1: Two clips on different tracks should not share one source node: there is one playback position per node, so they cannot be retriggered independently. The inspector warns you when that happens, with a Make Unique button that gives the clip its own copy of the node - same inputs, same modulations, its own position.
column2: 不同轨道上的两个片段不应共用同一个源节点：每个节点只有一个播放位置，因此无法独立重触发。出现这种情况时检查器会警告，并提供 Make Unique 按钮，给该片段一份自己的节点副本——相同的输入、相同的调制，但有独立的位置。

column1: Two independent wavetable engines with unison, filter, and pitch/filter/amp envelopes, mixed by an A/B control. With no note cable connected, it free-runs at a set frequency; connect a note cable and it becomes polyphonic and envelope-gated.
column2: 两个独立的波表引擎，带 unison、滤波器以及音高/滤波/音量包络，由 A/B 控件混合。未连接音符线时，以设定频率自由运行；连接音符线后变为复音并由包络门控。

column1: Two inputs and 32 blend modes - the full Normal / Multiply / Screen / Overlay / Hue / Saturation / Colour / Luminosity set, plus Erase.
column2: 两个输入和 32 种混合模式——完整的 Normal / Multiply / Screen / Overlay / Hue / Saturation / Colour / Luminosity 集合，外加 Erase。

column1: Type an exact value
column2: 输入精确数值

column1: Undo last graph action
column2: 撤销上一个图操作

column1: Unprojects a 2D depth map and optional color image into a 3D point cloud or triangulated surface mesh, supporting pinhole camera, planar, radial and cylindrical projections with depth curves and edge tearing.
column2: 将 2D 深度图和可选的彩色图像反投影为 3D 点云或三角化曲面网格，支持针孔相机、平面、径向和圆柱投影，带深度曲线和边缘撕裂。

column1: Unsharp mask - blurs a copy and adds back the difference.
column2: 非锐化遮罩——模糊一份副本并加回差值。

column1: Unsharp mask: blurs a copy of the image and adds back the difference, exaggerating edges. Amount is the strength, Radius how wide an edge it reacts to.
column2: 非锐化遮罩：模糊图像的副本并加回差值，强化边缘。Amount 为强度，Radius 为其响应的边缘宽度。

column1: Up to 16 parallel bandpass resonators forming a tuned modal filter bank, including a 'Metallic' tuning mode.
column2: 最多 16 个并联带通共振器，构成调谐的模态滤波器组，包含 'Metallic' 调谐模式。

column1: Uses a wavetable frame as a waveshaping transfer curve: the input sample's amplitude selects a phase into the table, the table's value there is the output. Drive past 0dB pushes the phase past the table's ends, where it wraps instead of clipping - true wavefolding, not distortion. Position morphs the curve across the table's 8 frames, smooth crosses to a lower-harmonic (darker) version of the same curve.
column2: 将波表帧用作波形整形传递曲线：输入采样的幅度选择表中的相位，表在该处的值即为输出。Drive 超过 0dB 会使相位超出表的两端，此时回绕而非削波——真正的波形折叠，而非失真。Position 在表的 8 帧之间渐变曲线，smooth 则渐变到同一曲线较低谐波（较暗）的版本。

column2: Using Feedback

column1: Utility node: audio routing, terminal/output nodes (shows, exports or records the final result), Syphon and OSC I/O.
column2: 工具节点：音频路由、终端/输出节点（显示、导出或录制最终结果）、Syphon 和 OSC I/O。

column1: Video tracks composite back to front, each clip with its own blend mode, opacity and brightness/contrast/saturation grade. Audio clips carry gain, pan, pitch and fades, summed per track. A clip's waveform is drawn from what was actually played, so a clip you have not played yet shows a flat line until the playhead has crossed it once.
column2: 视频轨道从后向前合成，每个片段有自己的混合模式、不透明度和亮度/对比度/饱和度调色。音频片段带有增益、声像、音高和淡入淡出，按轨道叠加。片段的波形根据实际播放的内容绘制，因此尚未播放过的片段会显示一条平线，直到播放头越过它一次。
